using Bank.API.Filters;
using Bank.API.MiddleWare;
using Bank.API.Services;
using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Data;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Services.AssemblyMarker;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Features;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;

namespace Bank
{
    public class Program
    {
        public static async Task Main(string[] args)
        {
            var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

            builder.Services.AddIdentity<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole<Guid>>(options =>
            {
                options.Password.RequireDigit = false;
                options.Password.RequireLowercase = false;
                options.Password.RequireNonAlphanumeric = false;
                options.Password.RequireUppercase = false;
                options.Password.RequiredLength = 6;
            })
            .AddEntityFrameworkStores<AppDbContext>()
            .AddDefaultTokenProviders();

            builder.Services.Configure<FormOptions>(options =>
            {
                options.MultipartBodyLengthLimit = 200L * 1024 * 1024;
            });
            builder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(options =>
            {
                options.Limits.MaxRequestBodySize = 200L * 1024 * 1024;
            });

            builder.Services.AddCors(options =>
            {
                options.AddPolicy("AllowFrontend", policy =>
                {
                    policy.AllowAnyOrigin()
                          .AllowAnyHeader()
                          .AllowAnyMethod();
                });
            });

            builder.Services.AddApplicationServices(builder.Configuration);
            builder.Services.AddAuthorization(options =>
            {
                options.AddPolicy("CanDownload", policy =>
                    policy.RequireAssertion(context =>
                        context.User.IsInRole("Admin") ||
                        context.User.IsInRole("SuperAdmin") ||
                        context.User.HasClaim("CanDownload", "true")));

            

                options.AddPolicy("CanUploadDataFiles", policy =>
                    policy.RequireAssertion(context =>
                        context.User.IsInRole("Admin") ||
                        context.User.IsInRole("SuperAdmin") ||
                        context.User.HasClaim("CanUploadDataFiles", "true")));
                options.AddPolicy("CanShare", policy =>
                    policy.RequireAssertion(context =>
                        context.User.IsInRole("Admin") ||
                        context.User.IsInRole("SuperAdmin") ||
                        context.User.HasClaim("CanShare", "true")));
                options.AddPolicy("CanUploadCheckFile", policy =>
                    policy.RequireAssertion(context =>
                        context.User.IsInRole("Admin") ||
                        context.User.IsInRole("SuperAdmin") ||
                        context.User.HasClaim("CanUploadCheckFile", "true")));
            });
            builder.Services.AddMemoryCache();
            var app = builder.Build();

            using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
            {
                await IdentitySeeder.SeedRolesAsync(scope.ServiceProvider);
                await IdentitySeeder.AddAdminAsync(scope.ServiceProvider);
            }

            app.UseMiddleware<ErrorHandlingMiddleWare>();

            app.UseSwagger();
            app.UseSwaggerUI(c =>
            {
                c.SwaggerEndpoint("/swagger/v1/swagger.json", "Base API v1");
            });

            app.UseHttpsRedirection();
            app.UseStaticFiles();
            app.UseCors("AllowFrontend");

            app.UseAuthentication();
            app.UseAuthorization();

            app.UseHangfireDashboard("/hangfire", new DashboardOptions
            {
                Authorization = new[] { new HangfireAuthorizationFilter() }
            });

            app.MapControllers();

            app.Run();
        }
    }
}

using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AdminDTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace Bank.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/admin")]
[Authorize(Roles = "Admin")]
public class AdminController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly IAdminService _adminService;
    private readonly ILogger<AdminController> _logger;

    public AdminController(IAdminService adminService, ILogger<AdminController> logger)
    {
        _adminService = adminService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Get all group members of the current admin's group with pagination support.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="pagination">Pagination parameters</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>Paginated list of group members</returns>

    [HttpGet("users")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyGroupMembers(
        [FromQuery] PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.GetMyGroupMembersAsync(CurrentUserId, pagination, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Get a specific group member by their ID within the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The ID of the group member to retrieve</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>The requested group member or not found</returns>

    [HttpGet("users/{id:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetMyGroupMemberById(
        Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.GetMyGroupMemberByIdAsync(CurrentUserId, id, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Update a specific group member's information within the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The ID of the group member to update</param>
    /// <param name="dto">The DTO containing the updated information</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>The updated group member or not found</returns>
    [HttpPut("users/{id:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateMyGroupMember(
        Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateGroupMemberDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.UpdateMyGroupMemberAsync(CurrentUserId, id, dto, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Remove a specific group member from the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The ID of the group member to remove</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>The result of the operation</returns>
    [HttpDelete("users/{id:guid}/group")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> RemoveUserFromMyGroup(
        Guid id, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.RemoveMemberFromMyGroupAsync(CurrentUserId, id, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Update a specific group member's permissions within the current admin's group.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="id">The ID of the group member whose permissions to update</param>
    /// <param name="dto">The DTO containing the updated permissions</param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken">Cancellation token</param>
    /// <returns>The updated group member or not found</returns>
    [HttpPut("users/{id:guid}/permissions")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> UpdateMemberPermissions(
        Guid id, [FromBody] UpdateUserPermissionDto dto, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _adminService.UpdateMemberPermissionsAsync(CurrentUserId, id, dto, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
}

using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.CheckFileDTos;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System.Security.Claims;

namespace Bank.API.Controllers;

[ApiController]
[Route("api/check-files")]
[Authorize]
public class CheckFilesController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ICheckFileService _checkFileService;
    private readonly ILogger<CheckFilesController> _logger;

    public CheckFilesController(ICheckFileService checkFileService, ILogger<CheckFilesController> logger)
    {
        _checkFileService = checkFileService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
    /// <summary>
    /// Get all check files for the current user
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpGet]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<IEnumerable<CheckFileSummaryDto>>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _checkFileService.GetCheckFilesAsync(CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Upload a new check file for the current user
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="request"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPost]
    [RequestSizeLimit(50_000_000)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<CheckFileSummaryDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Upload([FromForm] CreateCheckFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _checkFileService.UploadAsync(CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Toggle the active status of a check file for the current user
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="checkFileId"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpPatch("{checkFileId:guid}/toggle-active")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleActive(Guid checkFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _checkFileService.ToggleActiveAsync(checkFileId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
    /// <summary>
    /// Delete a check file for the current user
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="checkFileId"></param>
    /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
    /// <returns></returns>
    [HttpDelete("{checkFileId:guid}")]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
    [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid checkFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _checkFileService.DeleteAsync(checkFileId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
    }
}

using System.Security.Claims;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.LiveCheckDTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Bank.API.Controllers;

// â­ Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø²Ø¡ Ø§Ù„Ù€ REST Ø¨Ø³ (ØªØ§Ø±ÙŠØ®ØŒ Ù†ØªØ§Ø¦Ø¬ØŒ ØªØµØ¯ÙŠØ±ØŒ Ø­Ø°ÙØŒ ØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ ÙŠØ¯ÙˆÙŠ) â€” Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø²Ø¡ Ø§Ù„Ù„Ø­Ø¸ÙŠ

[ApiController]
[Route("api/check-sessions")]
[Authorize]
public class CheckSessionsController : ControllerBase
{
    private readonly ILiveCheckSessionService _service;

    public CheckSessionsController(ILiveCheckSessionService service)
    {
        _service = service;
    }

    private Guid CurrentUserId => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);

    /// <summary>ØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ ÙŠØ¯ÙˆÙŠ â€” standaloneØŒ Ø¨ÙŠØ¹Ù…Ù„ Ù…ÙŠÙ†ÙŠ-session Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø¯Ù‡ ÙˆØ¨ÙŠØ±Ø¬Ù‘Ø¹ Ø§Ù„Ù†ØªÙŠØ¬Ø© ÙÙˆØ±Ù‹Ø§.</summary>
    [HttpPost("manual-check")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> CreateManualCheck([FromBody] CreateManualLiveCheckRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _service.CreateManualCheckAsync(CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
        return result.Success ? Ok(result) : BadRequest(result);
    }

    [HttpGet]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _service.GetAllAsync(CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return result.Success ? Ok(result) : NotFound(result);
    }

    [HttpGet("{sessionId:guid}/plates")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> GetPlates(
        Guid sessionId, [FromQuery] int page = 1, [FromQuery] int pageSize = 50, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var result = await _service.GetPlatesAsync(sessionId, CurrentUserId, page, pageSize, cancellationToken);
        return result.Success ? Ok(result) : NotFound(result);
    }

    [HttpGet("{sessionId:guid}/export")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Export(Guid sessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        try
        {
            var (bytes, fileName) = await _service.ExportAsync(sessionId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return File(bytes, "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet", fileName);
        }
        catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
        {
            return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message));
        }
    }

    [HttpDelete("{sessionId:guid}")]
    public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid sessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _service.DeleteAsync(sessionId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (result.Success) return Ok(result);
        return result.StatusCode == 409 ? Conflict(result) : NotFound(result);
    }

    /// <summary>"Ù…Ø³Ø­ ÙƒÙ„ Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„Ø§Øª" â€” Ø­Ø°Ù Ù†Ù‡Ø§Ø¦ÙŠ Ù„ÙƒÙ„ Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø§Øª Ø§Ù„ØªØ´ÙŠÙŠÙƒ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù€ scope.</summary>
    [HttpDelete]
    public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var result = await _service.DeleteAllAsync(CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
        return result.Success ? Ok(result) : BadRequest(result);
    }
}

using System.Security.Claims;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.DataFileDTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Bank.API.Controllers
{
    [ApiController]
    [Route("api/data-files")]
    [Authorize]
    public class DataFilesController : ControllerBase
    {
        private readonly IDataFileService _dataFileService;
        private readonly ILogger<DataFilesController> _logger;

        public DataFilesController(IDataFileService dataFileService, ILogger<DataFilesController> logger)
        {
            _dataFileService = dataFileService;
            _logger = logger;
        }

        private Guid CurrentUserId => Guid.Parse(User.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets all data files for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpGet]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.GetDataFilesAsync(CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a new data file for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost]
        [RequestSizeLimit(200_000_000)]
        [Consumes("multipart/form-data")]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status202Accepted)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<Guid>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Create([FromForm] CreateDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.CreateDataFileAsync(CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Appends data to an existing data file for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dataFileId"></param>
        /// <param name="request"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPost("{dataFileId:guid}/append")]
        [Authorize(Policy = "CanAppendToTeamFiles")]
        [RequestSizeLimit(200_000_000)]
        [Consumes("multipart/form-data")]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status202Accepted)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Append(Guid dataFileId, [FromForm] AppendDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.AppendAsync(dataFileId, CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Toggles the active status of a data file for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dataFileId"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPatch("{dataFileId:guid}/toggle-active")]
       // [Authorize(Policy = "CanToggleFiles")]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ToggleActive(Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.ToggleActiveAsync(dataFileId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Reorders data files for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="request"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpPatch("reorder")]
        [Authorize(Policy = "CanToggleFiles")]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status400BadRequest)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Reorder([FromBody] ReorderDataFilesRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.ReorderAsync(CurrentUserId, request, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Deletes a data file for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dataFileId"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpDelete("{dataFileId:guid}")]
        [Authorize]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<bool>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.DeleteAsync(dataFileId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Downloads a data file for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dataFileId"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpGet("{dataFileId:guid}/download")]
        [Authorize(Policy = "CanDownload")]
        [Produces("application/octet-stream", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet")]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(FileResult), StatusCodes.Status200OK)]
        [ProducesResponseType(typeof(ApiResponse<object>), StatusCodes.Status404NotFound)]
        [ProducesResponseType(StatusCodes.Status403Forbidden)]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Download(Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            try
            {
                var (stream, contentType, fileName) = await _dataFileService.DownloadAsync(dataFileId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
                return File(stream, contentType, fileName);
            }
            catch (KeyNotFoundException ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Download failed for DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
                return NotFound(ApiResponse<object>.Fail(ex.Message));
            }
            catch (UnauthorizedAccessException ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Download unauthorized for DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
                return Forbid();
            }
        }
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the import status of a data file for the current user.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="dataFileId"></param>
        /// <param name="cancellationToken"></param>
        /// <returns></returns>
        [HttpGet("{dataFileId:guid}/import-status")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetImportStatus(Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var result = await _dataFileService.GetImportStatusAsync(dataFileId, CurrentUserId, cancellationToken);
            return StatusCode(result.StatusCode, result);
        }
    }
}

[Route("api/super-admin/admins")]

using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace Bank.API.Filters;

public class ErrorFilter : IAsyncActionFilter
{
    public async Task OnActionExecutionAsync(ActionExecutingContext context, ActionExecutionDelegate next)
    {
        var executedContext = await next();

        if (executedContext.Result is ObjectResult objectResult && objectResult.Value is IApiResponse apiResponse)
        {
            apiResponse.TraceId = context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier;

            if (!apiResponse.Success)
            {
                objectResult.StatusCode = apiResponse.StatusCode != 200 ? apiResponse.StatusCode : 400;
            }
        }
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.API\Filters\ResponseWrapperFilter.cs =====
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Filters;

namespace Bank.API.Filters;

public class ResponseWrapperFilter : IAsyncResultFilter
{
    public async Task OnResultExecutionAsync(ResultExecutingContext context, ResultExecutionDelegate next)
    {
        if (context.Result is ObjectResult objectResult)
        {
            if (objectResult.Value is IApiResponse apiResponse)
            {
                apiResponse.TraceId ??= context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier;
                if (objectResult.StatusCode.HasValue)
                    apiResponse.StatusCode = objectResult.StatusCode.Value;
            }
            else
            {
                var statusCode = objectResult.StatusCode ?? context.HttpContext.Response.StatusCode;
                var response = new ApiResponse<object>
                {
                    Success = statusCode is >= 200 and < 300,
                    Data = objectResult.Value,
                    Message = statusCode is >= 200 and < 300 ? "Success" : "Failed",
                    TraceId = context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier,
                    StatusCode = statusCode
                };

                context.Result = new ObjectResult(response)
                {
                    StatusCode = statusCode
                };
            }
        }
        else if (context.Result is StatusCodeResult statusCodeResult)
        {
            var isSuccess = statusCodeResult.StatusCode is >= 200 and < 300;
            var response = new ApiResponse<object>
            {
                Success = isSuccess,
                Data = null,
                Message = isSuccess ? "Success" : "Failed",
                TraceId = context.HttpContext.TraceIdentifier,
                StatusCode = statusCodeResult.StatusCode
            };

            context.Result = new ObjectResult(response)
            {
                StatusCode = statusCodeResult.StatusCode
            };
        }

        await next();
    }
}

using System.Security.Claims;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.SignalR;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.API.Hubs;

/// <summary>
/// ÙƒÙ„ Ø§ØªØµØ§Ù„ Flutter Ø¨ÙŠØ¹Ù…Ù„Ù‡ Ù‡Ù†Ø§ Ø¨ÙŠÙ…Ø± Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø±Ø§Ø­Ù„: StartSession â†’ SendAudioChunk*
/// (ÙˆUpdateLocation* Ø¨Ø§Ù„ØªÙˆØ§Ø²ÙŠ) â†’ StopSession (Ø£Ùˆ Ø§Ù†Ù‚Ø·Ø§Ø¹ Ù…ÙØ§Ø¬Ø¦ Ø¨ÙŠØªØ¹Ø§Ù…Ù„ Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù‡ OnDisconnectedAsync).

[Authorize]
public class LiveCheckHub : Hub
{
    private readonly ILiveCheckSessionService _sessionService;
    private readonly ILiveCheckAiConnector _aiConnector;
    private readonly ILiveCheckConnectionManager _connections;
    private readonly IHubContext<LiveCheckHub> _hubContext;
    private readonly ILogger<LiveCheckHub> _logger;

    public LiveCheckHub(
        ILiveCheckSessionService sessionService, ILiveCheckAiConnector aiConnector,
        ILiveCheckConnectionManager connections, IHubContext<LiveCheckHub> hubContext, ILogger<LiveCheckHub> logger)
    {
        _sessionService = sessionService;
        _aiConnector = aiConnector;
        _connections = connections;
        _hubContext = hubContext;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task StartSession(string district, string street, string? excelSheetName)
    {
        var userId = GetUserId();

        try
        {
            var (session, checkFileId) = await _sessionService.CreateSessionAsync(userId, district, street, excelSheetName);
            var aiSession = await _aiConnector.StartSessionAsync(Context.ConnectionAborted);

            var state = new LiveCheckConnectionState
            {
                SessionId = session.Id,
                UserId = userId,
                GroupId = session.GroupId,
                CheckFileId = checkFileId,
                District = district,
                Street = street,
                AiSession = aiSession
            };

            _connections.Add(Context.ConnectionId, state);

            // Ù…Ø´ Ø¨Ù†Ù†ØªØ¸Ø± Ø§Ù„Ù€ Task Ø¯Ù‡ Ù‡Ù†Ø§ â€” Ø§Ù„Ù€ Hub method Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ÙŠØ±Ø¬Ø¹ Ø¨Ø³Ø±Ø¹Ø©ØŒ ÙˆØ§Ù„Ø§Ø³ØªÙ…Ø§Ø¹
            // Ù„Ù„Ù†ØªØ§ÙŠØ¬ Ø´ØºØ§Ù„ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙÙŠØ© Ø·ÙˆÙ„ Ø¹Ù…Ø± Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø©.
            _ = ListenForDetectionsAsync(Context.ConnectionId, state);

            await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("SessionStarted", new { sessionId = session.Id, displayName = session.DisplayName });
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to start live check session for user {UserId}", userId);
            await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("Error", new { message = "ØªØ¹Ø°Ù‘Ø± Ø¨Ø¯Ø¡ Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø© Ø§Ù„ØªØ´ÙŠÙŠÙƒ." });
        }
    }

    public async Task SendAudioChunk(byte[] chunk)
    {
        var state = _connections.Get(Context.ConnectionId);
        if (state is null) return;

        try
        {
            await state.AiSession.SendAudioChunkAsync(chunk, Context.ConnectionAborted);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to forward audio chunk for connection {ConnectionId}", Context.ConnectionId);
        }
    }

    public Task UpdateLocation(double latitude, double longitude)
    {
        var state = _connections.Get(Context.ConnectionId);
        if (state is not null)
        {
            state.LastLatitude = latitude;
            state.LastLongitude = longitude;
        }
        return Task.CompletedTask;
    }

    public async Task StopSession()
    {
        var state = _connections.Get(Context.ConnectionId);
        if (state is null) return;

        await FinalizeSessionAsync(Context.ConnectionId, state);
        await Clients.Caller.SendAsync("SessionStopped", new { sessionId = state.SessionId });
    }

    public override async Task OnDisconnectedAsync(Exception? exception)
    {
        var state = _connections.Get(Context.ConnectionId);
        if (state is not null)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Connection {ConnectionId} dropped unexpectedly â€” finalizing CheckSession {SessionId}", Context.ConnectionId, state.SessionId);
            await FinalizeSessionAsync(Context.ConnectionId, state);
        }

        await base.OnDisconnectedAsync(exception);
    }

    private async Task ListenForDetectionsAsync(string connectionId, LiveCheckConnectionState state)
    {
        try
        {
            await foreach (var detection in state.AiSession.ReadDetectionsAsync(state.ListenCts.Token))
            {
                var result = await _sessionService.ProcessDetectionAsync(
                    state.SessionId, state.UserId, state.GroupId, state.CheckFileId, state.District, state.Street,
                    state.LastLatitude, state.LastLongitude, detection, Bank.Shared.Enums.CheckType.Live, CancellationToken.None);

                await _hubContext.Clients.Client(connectionId).SendAsync("PlateChecked", result);
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            // Ù…ØªÙˆÙ‚Ø¹ Ù„Ù…Ø§ StopSession/Disconnect ÙŠÙ„ØºÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù€ CancellationToken â€” Ù…Ø´ error Ø­Ù‚ÙŠÙ‚ÙŠ
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "AI listen loop failed for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
            await _hubContext.Clients.Client(connectionId).SendAsync("AiDisconnected", new { message = ex.Message });
            await _sessionService.MarkSessionFailedAsync(state.SessionId, ex.Message, CancellationToken.None);
            _connections.Remove(connectionId);
        }
    }

    private async Task FinalizeSessionAsync(string connectionId, LiveCheckConnectionState state)
    {
        state.ListenCts.Cancel();

        try
        {
            await state.AiSession.CloseAsync(CancellationToken.None);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error closing AI session for connection {ConnectionId}", connectionId);
        }

        await _sessionService.CompleteSessionAsync(state.SessionId, CancellationToken.None);
        _connections.Remove(connectionId);
    }

    private Guid GetUserId() => Guid.Parse(Context.User!.FindFirst(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier)!.Value);
}

using System.Net;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using SendGrid.Helpers.Errors.Model;

namespace Bank.API.MiddleWare;

public class ErrorHandlingMiddleWare
{
    private readonly RequestDelegate _next;
    private readonly ILogger<ErrorHandlingMiddleWare> _logger;
    private readonly IHostEnvironment _env;

    public ErrorHandlingMiddleWare(RequestDelegate next, ILogger<ErrorHandlingMiddleWare> logger, IHostEnvironment env)
    {
        _next = next;
        _logger = logger;
        _env = env;
    }

    public async Task InvokeAsync(HttpContext context)
    {
        try
        {
            await _next(context);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException)
        {
            _logger.LogInformation("Request was canceled by the client. Method: {Method} Path: {Path} TraceId: {TraceId}",
                context.Request.Method, context.Request.Path, context.TraceIdentifier);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled Exception while processing. Method: {Method} Path: {Path} TraceId: {TraceId}",
                context.Request.Method, context.Request.Path, context.TraceIdentifier);

            await HandleExceptionAsync(context, ex);
        }
    }

    private async Task HandleExceptionAsync(HttpContext context, Exception ex)
    {
        if (context.Response.HasStarted)
            return;

        var statusCode = ExceptionStatusCodeMapper.GetStatusCode(ex);
        context.Response.ContentType = "application/json";
        context.Response.StatusCode = statusCode;

        var errors = new List<string> { ex.Message };

        if (_env.IsDevelopment() && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ex.StackTrace))
        {
            errors.Add($"[{ex.GetType().Name}] {ex.StackTrace}");
        }

        var response = new ApiResponse<object>
        {
            Success = false,
            Message = GetTitleForStatusCode(statusCode),
            Data = null,
            Errors = errors,
            TraceId = context.TraceIdentifier,
            StatusCode = statusCode
        };

        await context.Response.WriteAsJsonAsync(response);
    }

    private static string GetTitleForStatusCode(int statusCode) => statusCode switch
    {
        400 => "Bad Request",
        401 => "Unauthorized",
        403 => "Forbidden",
        404 => "Resource Not Found",
        409 => "Conflict",
        _ => "An error occurred while processing your request."
    };

    public static class ExceptionStatusCodeMapper
    {
        public static int GetStatusCode(Exception ex) => ex switch
        {
            NotFoundException => (int)HttpStatusCode.NotFound,
            BadRequestException => (int)HttpStatusCode.BadRequest,
            UnauthorizedException => (int)HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized,
            ForbiddenException => (int)HttpStatusCode.Forbidden,
            _ => (int)HttpStatusCode.InternalServerError
        };
    }
}

using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.AspNetCore;
using Bank.API.Filters;
using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.Repo.Implementations;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Bank.Services.AssemblyMarker;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using Microsoft.OpenApi;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using Bank.Services.Implementations;
using Hangfire;
using Hangfire.SqlServer;
using Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;
namespace Bank.API.Services
{
    public static class ServiceCollectionExtentions
    {
        public static IServiceCollection AddApplicationServices(this IServiceCollection services,IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.AddDatabase(configuration);
            services.AddInfrastructureServices(configuration);
            services.AddSwaggerWithJWT();
            services.AddAuthenticationWithJWT(configuration);
            services.AddAPIBehavior(configuration);
            return services;
           
        }
        public static IServiceCollection AddDatabase(this IServiceCollection services,IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            var connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
            services
                 .AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(op => op
                 //.UseLazyLoadingProxies(true)
                 .UseSqlServer(connectionString,
                  sqlServerOptions => sqlServerOptions.UseNetTopologySuite()));

            services.AddHangfire(configuration => configuration
                .SetDataCompatibilityLevel(CompatibilityLevel.Version_180)
                .UseSimpleAssemblyNameTypeSerializer()
                .UseRecommendedSerializerSettings()
                .UseSqlServerStorage(connectionString, new SqlServerStorageOptions
                {
                    CommandBatchMaxTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
                    SlidingInvisibilityTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5),
                    QueuePollInterval = TimeSpan.Zero,
                    UseRecommendedIsolationLevel = true,
                    DisableGlobalLocks = true
                }));

            //services.AddHangfireServer(options =>
            //{
            //    options.Queues = new[] { "bulk-import", "default" };
            //    options.WorkerCount = 2; 
            //});
            services.AddHangfireServer(options =>
            {
               
                options.Queues = new[] { "default", "bulk-import", "recording-processing" };
                options.WorkerCount = 4;
            });
            services.AddScoped<DataFileImportJob>();
            return services;
        }
        public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructureServices(this IServiceCollection services,IConfiguration configuration)
        {
          
            services.AddFluentValidationAutoValidation();
            services.AddValidatorsFromAssemblyContaining<ApplicationAssemblyMarker>();
            services.AddAutoMapper(au => { },typeof(ApplicationAssemblyMarker).Assembly);
            services.AddScoped<IUnitOfWork, UnitOfWork>();
            services.AddScoped<IUserService, UserService>();
            services.AddScoped<IJWTService, JWTService>();
            services.AddScoped<IAuthService, AuthService>();
            services.AddScoped<IFileStorageService, LocalFileStorageService>();
            services.AddScoped<IDataFileService, DataFileService>();
            services.AddScoped<IAdminService, AdminService>();
            services.AddScoped<ISuperAdminService, SuperAdminService>();
            services.AddScoped<IReferralJobService, ReferralJobService>();
            services.AddScoped<ICheckFileService, CheckFileService>();
            services.AddScoped<IPlateColumnDetector, PlateColumnDetector>();
            services.AddScoped<ICheckPlateCacheService, CheckPlateCacheService>();
            services.AddScoped<ILookupService, LookupService>();
            services.AddScoped<DataFileImportJob>();
            services.AddScoped<ReferralMatchingJob>();
            services.AddScoped<IRecordingSessionService, RecordingSessionService>();
            services.AddHttpClient<IAiTranscriptionService, AiTranscriptionService>();



            return services;
        }
        public static IServiceCollection AddAPIBehavior(this IServiceCollection services,IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            services.AddControllers(x =>
            {
                x.Filters.Add<ErrorFilter>();
                x.Filters.Add<ResponseWrapperFilter>();
            }).AddJsonOptions(op =>
            {
                op.JsonSerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new JsonStringEnumConverter());
            });
            services.AddOpenApi();
            services.AddEndpointsApiExplorer();
            return services;
        }
        public static IServiceCollection AddSwaggerWithJWT(this IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddSwaggerGen(c =>
            {
                c.SwaggerDoc("v1", new OpenApiInfo
                {
                    Title = "Bank API",
                    Version = "v1",
                    Description = "Bank API with JWT Authentication"
                });

                // Include XML Comments
                var xmlFile = $"{Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly().GetName().Name}.xml";
                var xmlPath = Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, xmlFile);
                if (File.Exists(xmlPath))
                {
                    c.IncludeXmlComments(xmlPath);
                }

                // JWT Authentication Scheme
                c.AddSecurityDefinition("Bearer", new OpenApiSecurityScheme
                {
                    Name = "Authorization",
                    Type = SecuritySchemeType.Http,
                    Scheme = "Bearer",
                    BearerFormat = "JWT",
                    In = ParameterLocation.Header,
                    Description = "Enter your JWT token"
                });

                // Security Requirement (OpenAPI v2 style)
                c.AddSecurityRequirement(document =>
                {
                    return new OpenApiSecurityRequirement
                    {
                        [new OpenApiSecuritySchemeReference("Bearer", document)] = new List<string>()
                    };
                });
            });

            return services;
        }

        public static IServiceCollection AddAuthenticationWithJWT(this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(
                Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(configuration["Auth:JWT:Key"]
                    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("JWT Key is missing")));
            services.AddAuthentication(options =>
            {
                options.DefaultAuthenticateScheme =
                    JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;

                options.DefaultChallengeScheme =
                    JwtBearerDefaults.AuthenticationScheme;
            })
            .AddJwtBearer(options =>
            {
                options.TokenValidationParameters = new TokenValidationParameters
                {
                    ValidateIssuerSigningKey = true,
                    IssuerSigningKey = key,

                    ValidateIssuer = false,
                   // ValidIssuer = configuration["Auth:JWT:Issuer"],

                    ValidateAudience = false,
                   // ValidAudience = configuration["Auth:JWT:Audience"],

                    ValidateLifetime = false,
                   // ClockSkew = TimeSpan.Zero
                };
            });


            return services;
        }

    }

namespace Bank.DAL.Configration.BaseConfigrations;

public abstract class BaseEntityConfiguration<TEntity> : IEntityTypeConfiguration<TEntity>
    where TEntity : BaseEntity
{
    public virtual void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<TEntity> builder)
    {
        builder.HasKey(x => x.Id);

        builder.Property(x => x.Id)
            .HasColumnName("id")
            .HasDefaultValueSql("NEWSEQUENTIALID()")
            .ValueGeneratedOnAdd();
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Context\ApplicationDbContext.cs =====
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace Bank.DAL.Context;

public class AppDbContext : IdentityDbContext<ApplicationUser, IdentityRole<Guid>, Guid>
{
    public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options)
    {
    }

    public DbSet<RefreshToken> RefreshTokens => Set<RefreshToken>();
    public DbSet<AuditLog> AuditLogs => Set<AuditLog>();
    public DbSet<Group> Groups => Set<Group>();
    public DbSet<UserPermission> UserPermissions => Set<UserPermission>();
    public DbSet<CheckFile> CheckFiles => Set<CheckFile>();
    public DbSet<CheckPlate> CheckPlates => Set<CheckPlate>();
    public DbSet<RecordingSession> RecordingSessions => Set<RecordingSession>();
    public DbSet<RecordedPlate> RecordedPlates => Set<RecordedPlate>();
    public DbSet<LiveCheckLog> LiveCheckLogs => Set<LiveCheckLog>();
    public DbSet<DataFile> DataFiles => Set<DataFile>();
    public DbSet<HistoricalPlate> HistoricalPlates => Set<HistoricalPlate>();
    public DbSet<ReferralJob> ReferralJobs => Set<ReferralJob>();
    public DbSet<MatchResult> MatchResults => Set<MatchResult>();
    public DbSet<ReferralPlate> ReferralPlates => Set<ReferralPlate>();
    public DbSet<RecordingGpsPoint> RecordingGpsPoints => Set<RecordingGpsPoint>(); 
    public DbSet<CheckSession> CheckSessions => Set<CheckSession>();
    protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);

        modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly);

        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityRole<Guid>>().ToTable("roles");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserRole<Guid>>().ToTable("user_roles");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserClaim<Guid>>().ToTable("user_claims");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserLogin<Guid>>().ToTable("user_logins");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityRoleClaim<Guid>>().ToTable("role_claims");
        modelBuilder.Entity<IdentityUserToken<Guid>>().ToTable("user_tokens");
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Data\IdentitySeeder.cs =====
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.DAL.Data
{
    public static class IdentitySeeder
    {
        public static async Task SeedRolesAsync(IServiceProvider service)
        {
         using   var scope = service.CreateScope();
            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>>>();
         //   bool Studentexist = await roleManager.RoleExistsAsync(UserTypes.Student.ToString());

            foreach(var role in Enum.GetNames<UserRole>())
            {
                if (!await roleManager.RoleExistsAsync(role))
                    await roleManager.CreateAsync(new IdentityRole<Guid>(role));
            }
        }
        public static async Task AddAdminAsync(IServiceProvider service)
        {
            using var scope = service.CreateScope();
            var roleManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<RoleManager<IdentityRole<Guid>>>();
            var userManager = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<UserManager<ApplicationUser>>();
            var user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName="Super Admin",
                Email = "admin@gmail.com",
                EmailConfirmed = true,
                UserName = "admin@gmail.com",
                Role = UserRole.SuperAdmin,

                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };
            var Exist =await userManager.FindByEmailAsync(user.Email);
            if (Exist != null)
                return;
            var result = await userManager.CreateAsync(user, "**AAaa010");
            if (!result.Succeeded)
            {
                var errors = string.Join(",", result.Errors.Select(e => e.Description));
                throw new Exception($"failed to seed admin errors: {errors} ");
            }
            await userManager.AddToRoleAsync(user, UserTypes.SuperAdmin.ToString());

        }
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Models\BaseModels\BaseEntity.cs =====
namespace Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;

/// <summary>
/// Base class for every aggregate whose SQL Server primary key is a
/// uniqueidentifier (GUID) column, generated as NEWSEQUENTIALID() in the DB.
/// The Id is exposed as a string in the domain layer so that services,
/// DTOs and API contracts never need to know it is really a GUID.
/// </summary>
public abstract class BaseEntity
{
    public Guid Id { get; set; }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.DAL\Models\BaseModels\BaseEntityLong.cs =====
namespace Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;

/// <summary>
/// Base class for the high-volume "leaf" tables whose SQL Server primary key
/// is a bigint IDENTITY column (check_plates, recorded_plates, live_check_logs,
/// historical_plates, match_results, refresh_tokens, audit_logs).
/// These are kept as bigint (not string/GUID) on purpose: they are inserted
/// in bulk (2.7M+ rows for historical_plates) and a bigint identity is far
/// cheaper to index/cluster on than a GUID or string surrogate key.
/// </summary>
public abstract class BaseEntityLong
{
    public long Id { get; set; }
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Bank.Repo.Specifications;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Repo.Implementations
{
    public class GenericRepo<TEntity> : IGenericRepo<TEntity> where TEntity : BaseEntity
    {
       readonly AppDbContext _context;
       readonly DbSet<TEntity> dbset;
        public GenericRepo(AppDbContext context)
        {
            _context=context;
            dbset= context.Set<TEntity>();
        }
        public async Task<TEntity> AddAsync(TEntity entity)
        {
            await dbset.AddAsync(entity);
            return entity;
        }

        public async Task<IEnumerable<TEntity>> AddRangeAsync(IEnumerable<TEntity> entities)
        {
            await dbset.AddRangeAsync(entities);
            return entities;
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TEntity>> GetAllAsync(bool asNoTracking=false)
        {
          IQueryable<TEntity> query = dbset;
            if(asNoTracking)
                query=query.AsNoTracking();
            return await query.ToListAsync();
            
        }

        public async Task<TEntity> GetByIdAsync(Guid Id, bool asNoTracking=false)
        {
            IQueryable<TEntity>  query = dbset;
            if(asNoTracking)
                query = query.AsNoTracking();
            
           return await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x=>x.Id==Id);

        }
    

        public  Task RemoveAsync(TEntity item)
        {
            dbset.Remove(item);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public Task RemoveRangeAsync(IEnumerable<TEntity> entities)
        {
            dbset.RemoveRange(entities);
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }

        public  Task UpdateAsync(TEntity entity)
        {
            dbset.Update(entity);
           
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        }
        public  Task UpdateRangeAsync(List<TEntity>entities)
        {
            dbset.UpdateRange(entities);
           
            return Task.CompletedTask;

        }
        
        //Specifications
        private IQueryable<TEntity> ApplySpecification(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
          
            return SpecificationEvaluator<TEntity>.GetQuery(dbset.AsQueryable(), spec);
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TEntity>> SelectAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).ToListAsync();
          
        }
        public async Task<bool> AnyAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).AnyAsync();
          
        }
   

       public async Task<TEntity?> GetEntityWithSpecificationAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).FirstOrDefaultAsync();
        }

       public async Task<int> CountAsync(ISpecification<TEntity> spec)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).CountAsync();
        }

        public async Task<IReadOnlyList<TResult>> SelectAsync<TResult>(ISpecification<TEntity> spec
            ,Expression<Func<TEntity,TResult>> selector)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).Select(selector).ToListAsync();

        }

       public async Task<TResult?> GetEntityWithSpecificationAsync<TResult>(ISpecification<TEntity> spec,
           Expression<Func<TEntity,TResult>> selector) 
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).Select(selector).FirstOrDefaultAsync();

        }

        public async Task<TResult?> MaxAsync<TResult>(ISpecification<TEntity> spec, Expression<Func<TEntity, TResult>> selector)
        {
            return await ApplySpecification(spec).DefaultIfEmpty().MaxAsync(selector);

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Repo\Implementations\SpecificationEvaluator.cs =====
using Bank.Repo.Specifications;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
namespace Bank.Repo.Implementations
{
    public class SpecificationEvaluator<TEntity> where TEntity : BaseEntity
    {
        public static IQueryable<TEntity> GetQuery(
            IQueryable<TEntity> QueryInput,
            ISpecification<TEntity> spec
            )
        {
            var query = QueryInput.AsQueryable();
            if (spec.Criteria != null)
                query = query.Where(spec.Criteria);
            if (spec.AsNoTracking)
                query = query.AsNoTracking();

            if (spec.IsSplitQuery)
                query = query.AsSplitQuery();

            if (spec.Includes.Any())
                foreach ( var include in spec.Includes)
                query = query.Include(include);

            if (spec.AllIncludes.Any())
                foreach (var include in spec.AllIncludes)
                    query = include(query);

            if (spec.OrderBy != null)
                query= query.OrderBy(spec.OrderBy);
            else if(spec.OrderByDescending != null)
            {
                query= query.OrderByDescending(spec.OrderByDescending);
            }

            if (spec.IsPaginable)
            {
               query=query.Skip(spec.Skip).Take(spec.Take);
            }
           
            return query;
        }
    }
}


===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Repo\Implementations\UnitOfWork.cs =====
using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Repo.Implementations
{
    public  class UnitOfWork : IUnitOfWork
    {
        AppDbContext _context;
        Dictionary<Type, object> repositories = new Dictionary<Type, object>();
        public UnitOfWork(AppDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;

        }
        public  IGenericRepo<T> Repository<T>() where T : BaseEntity
        {
            var type=typeof(T);
            if (!repositories.ContainsKey(type))
            {
                var repo =new GenericRepo<T>(_context);
                repositories.Add(type, repo);

            }

          return (IGenericRepo<T>) repositories[type];
        }
        public async Task<int> CompleteAsync()
        {
            return await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }
    }
}

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Query;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq.Expressions;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Repo.Specifications
{
    public class BaseSpecification<T> : ISpecification<T> where T : BaseEntity
    {
        private readonly List<Expression<Func<T, object>>> _include = new();
        private readonly List<Func<IQueryable<T>,IIncludableQueryable<T,object>>> _allIncude= new();
        public Expression<Func<T, bool>>? Criteria { get; private set; }

        public IReadOnlyList<Expression<Func<T, object>>> Includes  => _include;

        public IReadOnlyList<Func<IQueryable<T>, IIncludableQueryable<T, object>>> AllIncludes => _allIncude;

       public Expression<Func<T, object>>? OrderBy { get; private set; }

       public Expression<Func<T, object>>? OrderByDescending { get;private set; }

       public int Skip { get;private set;  }

       public int Take {  get;private set; }

       public bool IsPaginable {  get;private set; }
        public bool AsNoTracking { get;private set; }
        public bool IsSplitQuery { get;private set; }

       

        public BaseSpecification()
        {
            
        }
        public BaseSpecification(Expression<Func<T,bool>> CriteriaExpression)
        {
            Criteria = CriteriaExpression;
        }
        public void AddInclude(Expression<Func<T,object>> IncludeExpression)=>_include.Add(IncludeExpression);
        public void AddInclude(Func<IQueryable<T>,IIncludableQueryable<T,object>>AllIncludeExpression)=>_allIncude.Add(AllIncludeExpression);
        public void AddOrderBy(Expression<Func<T,object>>OrderByExpression)=>OrderBy = OrderByExpression;
        
        public void AddOrderByDesc(Expression<Func<T,object>>OrderByDescExpression)=> OrderByDescending=OrderByDescExpression;
        
        public void ApplyPagination(int skip,int take)
        {
            Skip = skip;
            Take = take;
            IsPaginable = true;
        }
        public void ApplyNoTracking()=> AsNoTracking = true;
        public void ApplySplitQuery()=> IsSplitQuery = true;
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Query;

namespace Bank.Repo.Specifications
{
    public interface ISpecification<T>
    {

        IReadOnlyList<Func<IQueryable<T>,IIncludableQueryable<T,object>>> AllIncludes { get; }
        Expression<Func<T,object>>? OrderBy { get; }
        Expression<Func<T,object>>? OrderByDescending { get; }
        int Skip { get; }

        bool IsPaginable { get; }

        bool IsSplitQuery { get; }
    }

using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;

[Queue("bulk-import")]
public class DataFileImportJob
{
    private const int BatchSize = 25_000;
    private const int BulkCopyTimeoutSeconds = 600;

    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IFileStorageService _fileStorage;
    private readonly ILogger<DataFileImportJob> _logger;

    static DataFileImportJob()
    {
        Encoding.RegisterProvider(CodePagesEncodingProvider.Instance);
    }

    public DataFileImportJob(AppDbContext dbContext, IFileStorageService fileStorage, ILogger<DataFileImportJob> logger)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _fileStorage = fileStorage;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 1, OnAttemptsExceeded = AttemptsExceededAction.Fail)]
    public async Task ImportAsync(Guid dataFileId, Guid userId, string storagePath, bool isAppend, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var totalStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
        _logger.LogInformation("Import job started for DataFile {DataFileId} (append={IsAppend})", dataFileId, isAppend);

        var connectionString = _dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (!isAppend)
        {
            var deleteStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var replaced = await DeleteHistoricalPlatesAsync(connection, dataFileId, cancellationToken);
            deleteStopwatch.Stop();
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PHASE delete: cleared {Count} existing rows for DataFile {DataFileId} in {ElapsedMs}ms",
                replaced, dataFileId, deleteStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);
        }

        await using var transaction = (SqlTransaction)await connection.BeginTransactionAsync(cancellationToken);

        try
        {
            var parseAndInsertStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            await using var stream = await _fileStorage.OpenReadAsync(storagePath, cancellationToken);
            var extension = Path.GetExtension(storagePath).ToLowerInvariant();

            int totalInserted;
            if (extension == ".csv")
            {
                using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
                var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                {
                    HasHeaderRecord = true,
                    MissingFieldFound = null,
                    BadDataFound = null
                };
                using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);
                await csv.ReadAsync();
                csv.ReadHeader();
                var map = DetectColumnsFromHeaders(csv.HeaderRecord ?? Array.Empty<string>());

                using var readerWrapper = new CsvDataReaderWrapper(csv, map, dataFileId, userId);
                totalInserted = await ExecuteBulkCopyAsync(connection, transaction, readerWrapper, cancellationToken);
            }
            else
            {
                using var excelReader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
                var map = DetectColumnsFromExcel(excelReader);
                using var readerWrapper = new ExcelDataReaderWrapper(excelReader, map, dataFileId, userId);
                totalInserted = await ExecuteBulkCopyAsync(connection, transaction, readerWrapper, cancellationToken);
            }

            parseAndInsertStopwatch.Stop();
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PHASE parse+insert: {Rows} rows for DataFile {DataFileId} in {ElapsedMs}ms ({RowsPerSec:F0} rows/sec)",
                totalInserted, dataFileId, parseAndInsertStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                totalInserted / Math.Max(1.0, parseAndInsertStopwatch.Elapsed.TotalSeconds));

            var commitStopwatch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            await using (var updateCommand = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                updateCommand.Transaction = transaction;
                updateCommand.CommandText = isAppend
                    ? "UPDATE data_files SET row_count = row_count + @rows, import_status = @status, import_error = NULL WHERE id = @id"
                    : "UPDATE data_files SET row_count = @rows, import_status = @status, is_active_for_filtering = 1, import_error = NULL WHERE id = @id";

                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@rows", totalInserted);
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", nameof(DataFileImportStatus.Completed));
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", dataFileId);
                await updateCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            await transaction.CommitAsync(cancellationToken);
            commitStopwatch.Stop();

            totalStopwatch.Stop();
            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PHASE commit: {ElapsedMs}ms | TOTAL import for DataFile {DataFileId}: {TotalMs}ms ({TotalRows} rows)",
                commitStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, dataFileId, totalStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds, totalInserted);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            await transaction.RollbackAsync(cancellationToken);
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Import job failed for DataFile {DataFileId} after {ElapsedMs}ms", dataFileId, totalStopwatch.ElapsedMilliseconds);

            await _dbContext.DataFiles
                .Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(f => f.ImportStatus, DataFileImportStatus.Failed)
                    .SetProperty(f => f.ImportError, ex.Message),
                    cancellationToken);

            throw;
        }
    }

    [Queue("bulk-import")]
    public async Task DeleteAsync(Guid dataFileId, string storagePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Delete job started for DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);

        var connectionString = _dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        await DeleteHistoricalPlatesAsync(connection, dataFileId, cancellationToken);

        await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId)
            .ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

        await _fileStorage.DeleteAsync(storagePath, cancellationToken);
        _logger.LogInformation("Delete job completed for DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
    }

    private static async Task<int> DeleteHistoricalPlatesAsync(
        SqlConnection connection, Guid dataFileId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var totalDeleted = 0;
        int deletedInBatch;
        do
        {
            await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
            command.CommandText = $"DELETE TOP ({BatchSize}) FROM historical_plates WHERE data_file_id = @dataFileId";
            command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@dataFileId", dataFileId);
            deletedInBatch = await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
            totalDeleted += deletedInBatch;
        }
        while (deletedInBatch > 0);

        return totalDeleted;
    }

    private static async Task<int> ExecuteBulkCopyAsync(
        SqlConnection connection, SqlTransaction transaction, IDataReader reader, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        using var bulkCopy = new SqlBulkCopy(connection, SqlBulkCopyOptions.TableLock, transaction)
        {
            DestinationTableName = "historical_plates",
            BatchSize = BatchSize,
            BulkCopyTimeout = BulkCopyTimeoutSeconds,
            EnableStreaming = true
        };

        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(0, "data_file_id");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(1, "user_id");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(2, "raw_plate");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(3, "normalized_plate");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(4, "vehicle_type");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(5, "district");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(6, "street");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(7, "location");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add(8, "recorded_at");

        await bulkCopy.WriteToServerAsync(reader, cancellationToken);
        return ((IRowCounter)reader).TotalReadRows;
    }

    private static ColumnMapping DetectColumnsFromExcel(IExcelDataReader reader)
    {
        var map = new ColumnMapping();
        while (reader.Read())
        {
            for (int i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                var val = reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
                AssignColumn(map, val, i);
            }
            if (map.PlateCol != -1) break;
        }
        return map;
    }

    private static ColumnMapping DetectColumnsFromHeaders(string[] headers)
    {
        var map = new ColumnMapping();
        for (int i = 0; i < headers.Length; i++)
        {
            AssignColumn(map, headers[i]?.Trim() ?? string.Empty, i);
        }
        return map;
    }

    private static void AssignColumn(ColumnMapping map, string header, int index)
    {
        if (header.Contains("لوحة") || header.Contains("اللوحة")) map.PlateCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("نوع") || header.Contains("السيارة")) map.VehicleTypeCol = index;
        else if (header.Equals("الشارع")) map.StreetCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("الحي")) map.DistrictCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("GPS") || header.Contains("الموقع") || header.Contains("رابط")) map.GpsCol = index;
        else if (header.Contains("تاريخ") || header.Contains("التسجيل")) map.RecordedAtCol = index;
    }

    private interface IRowCounter
    {
        int TotalReadRows { get; }
    }

    private sealed class ExcelDataReaderWrapper : DbDataReader, IRowCounter
    {
        private readonly IExcelDataReader _reader;
        private readonly ColumnMapping _map;
        private readonly Guid _dataFileId;
        private readonly Guid _userId;
        private readonly object?[] _currentValues = new object?[9];
        public int TotalReadRows { get; private set; }

        public ExcelDataReaderWrapper(IExcelDataReader reader, ColumnMapping map, Guid dataFileId, Guid userId)
        {
            _reader = reader;
            _map = map;
            _dataFileId = dataFileId;
            _userId = userId;
        }
       
        public override bool Read()
        {
            while (_reader.Read())
            {
                var rawPlate = _map.PlateCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.PlateCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : null;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate) || rawPlate == "1" || rawPlate.Contains("لوحة"))
                    continue;

                _currentValues[0] = _dataFileId;
                _currentValues[1] = _userId;
                _currentValues[2] = rawPlate;
                _currentValues[3] = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(rawPlate);
                _currentValues[4] = _map.VehicleTypeCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.VehicleTypeCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[5] = _map.DistrictCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.DistrictCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[6] = _map.StreetCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.StreetCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;
                _currentValues[7] = _map.GpsCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.GpsCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : DBNull.Value;

                var recordedAtRaw = _map.RecordedAtCol != -1 ? _reader.GetValue(_map.RecordedAtCol)?.ToString()?.Trim() : null;
                _currentValues[8] = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(recordedAtRaw) ? recordedAtRaw : DBNull.Value;

                TotalReadRows++;
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        public override object this[int ordinal] => GetValue(ordinal);
        public override object this[string name] => GetValue(GetOrdinal(name));
        public override int Depth => 0;
        public override bool NextResult() => false;
        public override object GetValue(int ordinal) => _currentValues[ordinal] ?? DBNull.Value;
        public override int FieldCount => 9;
        public override bool HasRows => true;
        public override bool IsClosed => _reader.IsClosed;
        public override int RecordsAffected => -1;
        public override int GetValues(object[] values) { Array.Copy(_currentValues, values, 9); return 9; }
        public override bool IsDBNull(int ordinal) => _currentValues[ordinal] == null || _currentValues[ordinal] == DBNull.Value;
        public override string GetName(int ordinal) => ordinal.ToString();
        public override int GetOrdinal(string name) => int.Parse(name);
        public override string GetDataTypeName(int ordinal) => typeof(object).Name;
        public override Type GetFieldType(int ordinal) => typeof(object);
        public override System.Collections.IEnumerator GetEnumerator() => _currentValues.GetEnumerator();
        public override bool GetBoolean(int ordinal) => (bool)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override byte GetByte(int ordinal) => (byte)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override long GetBytes(int ordinal, long dataOffset, byte[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length) => 0;
        public override char GetChar(int ordinal) => (char)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override long GetChars(int ordinal, long dataOffset, char[]? buffer, int bufferOffset, int length) => 0;
        public override Guid GetGuid(int ordinal) => (Guid)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override short GetInt16(int ordinal) => (short)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override int GetInt32(int ordinal) => (int)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override long GetInt64(int ordinal) => (long)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override string GetString(int ordinal) => (string)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override decimal GetDecimal(int ordinal) => (decimal)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override double GetDouble(int ordinal) => (double)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override float GetFloat(int ordinal) => (float)GetValue(ordinal);
        public override DateTime GetDateTime(int ordinal) => (DateTime)GetValue(ordinal);
    }
