using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using NetTopologySuite.Geometries;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;

[Queue("recording-processing")]
public class RecordingProcessingJob
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IFileStorageService _fileStorage;
    private readonly IAiTranscriptionService _aiService;
    private readonly ILogger<RecordingProcessingJob> _logger;

    public RecordingProcessingJob(
        AppDbContext dbContext, IFileStorageService fileStorage, IAiTranscriptionService aiService, ILogger<RecordingProcessingJob> logger)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _fileStorage = fileStorage;
        _aiService = aiService;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 1, OnAttemptsExceeded = AttemptsExceededAction.Fail)]
    public async Task ProcessAsync(Guid sessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Recording processing job started for Session {SessionId}", sessionId);

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
            .Select(s => new { s.StartedAt, s.CheckFileId, s.AudioUrl, s.UserId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (session is null || session.AudioUrl is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("RecordingSession {SessionId} not found or has no audio â€” aborting", sessionId);
            return;
        }

        try
        {
            await using var audioStream = await _fileStorage.OpenReadAsync(session.AudioUrl, cancellationToken);
            var aiResult = await _aiService.TranscribeAsync(audioStream, "recording.aac", "audio/aac", cancellationToken);

            var gpsPoints = await _dbContext.RecordingGpsPoints
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(g => g.SessionId == sessionId)
                .OrderBy(g => g.CapturedAt)
                .Select(g => new GpsPointDto(
        g.Location,
        g.CapturedAt))/*(g => new { g.Location, g.CapturedAt })*/
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            var checkPlatesLookup = session.CheckFileId is null
                ? new Dictionary<string, long>()
                : await _dbContext.CheckPlates
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(cp => cp.CheckFileId == session.CheckFileId.Value)
                    .ToDictionaryAsync(cp => cp.NormalizedPlate, cp => cp.Id, cancellationToken);

            var recordedPlates = new List<RecordedPlate>();
            var sequence = 0;

            foreach (var car in aiResult.Cars)
            {
                sequence++;
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(car.PlateNumber)) continue;

                var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(car.PlateNumber);

                
                var effectiveOffsetMs = car.TimestampStartMs.HasValue && car.TimestampEndMs.HasValue
                    ? (car.TimestampStartMs.Value + car.TimestampEndMs.Value) / 2
                    : car.TimestampMs;

                var recordedAt = session.StartedAt.AddMilliseconds(effectiveOffsetMs);
                var nearestLocation = FindNearestGpsPoint(gpsPoints, recordedAt);

                var isMatched = checkPlatesLookup.TryGetValue(normalized, out var matchedCheckPlateId);

                recordedPlates.Add(new RecordedPlate
                {
                    SessionId = sessionId,
                    UserId = session.UserId,
                    SequenceNumber = sequence,
                    RawPlate = car.PlateNumber,
                    NormalizedPlate = normalized,
                    VehicleType = car.VehicleType,
                    Notes = car.Notes,
                    Location = nearestLocation,
                    AudioOffsetMs = effectiveOffsetMs,
                    IsMatched = isMatched,
                    MatchedCheckPlateId = isMatched ? matchedCheckPlateId : null,
                    IsManualEntry = false,
                    RecordedAt = recordedAt
                });
            }

            await _dbContext.RecordedPlates.AddRangeAsync(recordedPlates, cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
                .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(s => s.TotalPlates, recordedPlates.Count)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.TotalGpsPoints, gpsPoints.Count)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Completed)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.EndedAt, DateTime.UtcNow)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.ProcessingError, (string?)null),
                    cancellationToken);

            await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Recording processing completed for Session {SessionId}: {PlateCount} plates, {MatchedCount} matched",
                sessionId, recordedPlates.Count, recordedPlates.Count(p => p.IsMatched));
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Recording processing failed for Session {SessionId}", sessionId);

            await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
                .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
                .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                    .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Failed)
                    .SetProperty(s => s.ProcessingError, ex.Message),
                    cancellationToken);

            throw;
        }
    }

    
    private static NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point? FindNearestGpsPoint(
        List<GpsPointDto> orderedGpsPoints, DateTime targetTime)
    {
        if (orderedGpsPoints.Count == 0) return null;

        NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point? nearest = null;
        var smallestDiff = TimeSpan.MaxValue;

        foreach (var point in orderedGpsPoints)
        {
            TimeSpan diff = ((DateTime)point.CapturedAt - targetTime).Duration();
            if (diff < smallestDiff)
            {
                smallestDiff = diff;
                nearest = (NetTopologySuite.Geometries.Point)point.Location;
            }
        }

        return nearest;
    }
    private sealed record GpsPointDto(
    Point? Location,
    DateTime CapturedAt);
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Hangfire;
using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;


[Queue("bulk-import")]
public class ReferralMatchingJob
{
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly ILogger<ReferralMatchingJob> _logger;

    public ReferralMatchingJob(AppDbContext dbContext, ILogger<ReferralMatchingJob> logger)
    {
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [AutomaticRetry(Attempts = 1, OnAttemptsExceeded = AttemptsExceededAction.Fail)]
    public async Task ProcessAsync(Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        _logger.LogInformation("Referral matching job started for ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}", referralJobId);

        var job = await _dbContext.ReferralJobs
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(j => j.Id == referralJobId)
            .Select(j => new { j.FilterType, j.GroupId, j.UserId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (job is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("ReferralJob {ReferralJobId} not found â€” aborting matching job", referralJobId);
            return;
        }

        var connectionString = _dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        try
        {
            if (job.FilterType == FilterType.New)
            {
                await MarkSkippedFromActiveCheckFileAsync(connection, referralJobId, job.GroupId, job.UserId, cancellationToken);
            }

            await InsertMatchResultsAsync(connection, referralJobId, job.GroupId, job.UserId, cancellationToken);
            await MarkMatchedAsync(connection, referralJobId, cancellationToken);

            var skippedCount = await CountByStatusAsync(connection, referralJobId, ReferralPlateStatus.Skipped, cancellationToken);
            var matchedCount = await CountByStatusAsync(connection, referralJobId, ReferralPlateStatus.Matched, cancellationToken);

            await using (var updateCommand = connection.CreateCommand())
            {
                updateCommand.CommandText =
                    "UPDATE referral_jobs SET skipped_plates_count = @skipped, matched_plates_count = @matched, status = @status WHERE id = @id";
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@skipped", skippedCount);
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@matched", matchedCount);
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", nameof(JobStatus.Completed));
                updateCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", referralJobId);
                await updateCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
            }

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Referral matching job completed for ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}: skipped={Skipped}, matched={Matched}",
                referralJobId, skippedCount, matchedCount);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Referral matching job failed for ReferralJob {ReferralJobId}", referralJobId);

            await using var failCommand = connection.CreateCommand();
            failCommand.CommandText = "UPDATE referral_jobs SET status = @status WHERE id = @id";
            failCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", nameof(JobStatus.Failed));
            failCommand.Parameters.AddWithValue("@id", referralJobId);
            await failCommand.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);

            throw;
        }
    }

    private static async Task MarkSkippedFromActiveCheckFileAsync(
        SqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, Guid? groupId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = @"
            UPDATE rp
            SET rp.status = 'Skipped'
            FROM referral_plates rp
            WHERE rp.referral_job_id = @jobId
              AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM check_plates cp
                    JOIN check_files cf ON cf.id = cp.check_file_id
                    WHERE cf.is_active = 1
                      AND cp.normalized_plate = rp.normalized_plate
                      AND (
                            (@groupId IS NOT NULL AND cf.group_id = @groupId)
                         OR (@groupId IS NULL AND cf.group_id IS NULL AND cf.uploaded_by = @userId)
                      )
              );";

        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@groupId", (object?)groupId ?? DBNull.Value);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@userId", userId);
        await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task InsertMatchResultsAsync(
        SqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, Guid? groupId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = @"
            INSERT INTO match_results
                (referral_job_id, historical_plate_id, normalized_plate, found_vehicle_type,
                 found_district, found_street, location, found_recorded_at, source_data_file_id, matched_at)
            SELECT
                @jobId, hp.id, rp.normalized_plate, hp.vehicle_type,
                hp.district, hp.street, hp.location, hp.recorded_at, hp.data_file_id, SYSUTCDATETIME()
            FROM referral_plates rp
            JOIN historical_plates hp ON hp.normalized_plate = rp.normalized_plate
            JOIN data_files df ON df.id = hp.data_file_id AND df.is_active_for_filtering = 1
            WHERE rp.referral_job_id = @jobId
              AND rp.status <> 'Skipped'
              AND (
                    (@groupId IS NOT NULL AND df.group_id = @groupId)
                 OR (@groupId IS NULL AND df.group_id IS NULL AND df.owner_id = @userId)
              );";

        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@groupId", (object?)groupId ?? DBNull.Value);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@userId", userId);
        command.CommandTimeout = 300;
        await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task MarkMatchedAsync(SqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = @"
            UPDATE rp
            SET rp.status = 'Matched'
            FROM referral_plates rp
            WHERE rp.referral_job_id = @jobId
              AND rp.status <> 'Skipped'
              AND EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM match_results mr
                    WHERE mr.referral_job_id = @jobId
                      AND mr.normalized_plate = rp.normalized_plate
              );";
       

        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        await command.ExecuteNonQueryAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task<int> CountByStatusAsync(
        SqlConnection connection, Guid referralJobId, ReferralPlateStatus status, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        await using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
        command.CommandText = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM referral_plates WHERE referral_job_id = @jobId AND status = @status";
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@jobId", referralJobId);
        command.Parameters.AddWithValue("@status", status.ToString());
        var result = await command.ExecuteScalarAsync(cancellationToken);
        return Convert.ToInt32(result);
    }
}

using CsvHelper;
using CsvHelper.Configuration;
using ExcelDataReader;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers
{
    public sealed record ExcelSheetInfo(int Index, string Name, int RowCount);

    public sealed record ExcelSheetData(int Index, string Name, List<List<string?>> Rows);

    public static class ExcelSheetReader
    {
        /// <summary>بيرجّع أسامي الـ Sheets وعدد صفوفها بس — من غير ما يجهّز محتوى الخلايا (أخف على الذاكرة).</summary>
        public static List<ExcelSheetInfo> GetSheetsInfo(Stream stream, string extension)
        {
            if (extension == ".csv")
            {
                using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
                var rowCount = 0;
                while (textReader.ReadLine() is not null) rowCount++;
                return new List<ExcelSheetInfo> { new(0, "CSV", rowCount) };
            }

            var result = new List<ExcelSheetInfo>();
            using var reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
            var sheetIndex = 0;

            do
            {
                var rowCount = 0;
                while (reader.Read()) rowCount++; // بنعد الصفوف بس من غير قراءة الخلايا
                result.Add(new ExcelSheetInfo(sheetIndex, reader.Name, rowCount));
                sheetIndex++;
            }
            while (reader.NextResult());

            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>بيقرأ محتوى الـ Sheets المختارة بس (أو كلها لو allSheets=true).</summary>
        public static List<ExcelSheetData> ReadSelectedSheets(
            Stream stream, string extension, bool allSheets, List<int>? selectedIndexes)
        {
            if (extension == ".csv")
            {
                using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
                var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
                {
                    HasHeaderRecord = false,
                    MissingFieldFound = null,
                    BadDataFound = null
                };
                using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);

                var rows = new List<List<string?>>();
                while (csv.Read())
                {
                    var record = csv.Parser.Record;
                    rows.Add(record?.Select(v => (string?)v).ToList() ?? new List<string?>());
                }

                return new List<ExcelSheetData> { new(0, "CSV", rows) };
            }

            var selectedSet = selectedIndexes is null ? null : new HashSet<int>(selectedIndexes);
            var result = new List<ExcelSheetData>();

            using var reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
            var sheetIndex = 0;

            do
            {
                var include = allSheets || (selectedSet?.Contains(sheetIndex) ?? false);
                if (!include)
                {
                    sheetIndex++;
                    continue;
                }

                var rows = new List<List<string?>>();
                while (reader.Read())
                {
                    var row = new List<string?>(reader.FieldCount);
                    for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
                    {
                        row.Add(reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim());
                    }
                    rows.Add(row);
                }

                result.Add(new ExcelSheetData(sheetIndex, reader.Name, rows));
                sheetIndex++;
            }
            while (reader.NextResult());

            return result;
        }
    }

}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers
{
    public static class FileHelper
    {
        public static string? ValidateUploadedFile(IFormFile file,long MaxUploadSizeBytes ,string[] AllowedExtensions)
        {
            if (file is null || file.Length == 0)
            {
                return "لازم ترفع ملف.";
            }

            if (file.Length > MaxUploadSizeBytes)
            {
                return $"حجم الملف أكبر من الحد المسموح ({MaxUploadSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024} MB).";
            }

            var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
            if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension))
            {
                return $"صيغة الملف غير مدعومة. المسموح: {string.Join(", ", AllowedExtensions)}";
            }

            return null;
        }
    }
}

namespace Bank.Services.Helpers;


public static class LocationLinkHelper

    public static string? ToGoogleMapsLink(Point? point)
    {
        if (point is null) return null;

        // NetTopologySuite: X = Longitude, Y = Latitude
        return $"https://www.google.com/maps?q={point.Y.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)},{point.X.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}";
    }
    public static string ToGoogleMapsLink(double latitude, double longitude)
    {
        return $"https://www.google.com/maps?q={latitude.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)},{longitude.ToString("F6", System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)}";
    }

    public static Point ToPoint(double latitude, double longitude)
    {
        return new Point(longitude, latitude) { SRID = 4326 };
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Services\Helpers\PlateNormalizer.cs =====
using System.Text;
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;

namespace Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;


public static class PlateNormalizer
{
    public static string Normalize(string? input)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(input)) return string.Empty;

        var normalized = input.Normalize(NormalizationForm.FormC);
        var sb = new StringBuilder(normalized.Length);

        foreach (var ch in normalized)
        {
            if (char.IsWhiteSpace(ch) || ch == '\u0640' || (ch >= '\u064B' && ch <= '\u065F'))
            {
                continue;
            }

     

           
            var mappedChar = ch switch
            {
                'Ø£' or 'Ø¥' or 'Ø¢' or 'Ù±' => 'Ø§',
                'Ø©' => 'Ù‡',
                'Ù‰' => 'ÙŠ',
                'Ø¤' => 'Ùˆ',
                'Ø¦' => 'ÙŠ',
                _ => char.ToUpperInvariant(ch) 
            };

            sb.Append(mappedChar);
        }

        return sb.ToString().Trim();
    }

    //public static string Normalize(string rawPlate)
    //{
    //    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate)) return string.Empty;
    //    return rawPlate.Replace(" ", "").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
    //}


    public static string NormalizeReferralPlate(string rawPlate)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate)) return string.Empty;

        var cleaned = rawPlate.Replace(" ", "").Replace("-", "").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        cleaned = ConvertArabicIndicDigitsToWestern(cleaned);

        var match = ReferralPlatePattern.Match(cleaned);
        if (!match.Success)
        {
       
            return cleaned;
        }

        var letters = match.Groups[1].Value;
        var digits = match.Groups[2].Value;

       
        var paddedDigits = digits.Length >= 4 ? digits : digits.PadLeft(4, '0');

        return letters + paddedDigits;
    }

    private static readonly Regex ReferralPlatePattern =
        new(@"^([A-Za-z\u0621-\u064A]+)([0-9]*)$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private static string ConvertArabicIndicDigitsToWestern(string input)
    {
        var builder = new StringBuilder(input.Length);
        foreach (var ch in input)
        {
            if (ch is >= '\u0660' and <= '\u0669')
            {
                builder.Append((char)('0' + (ch - '\u0660')));
            }
            else
            {
                builder.Append(ch);
            }
        }
        return builder.ToString();
    }
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AdminDTOs;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class AdminService : IAdminService
{
    private IUserService _userService;
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unitOfWork;
    private readonly AppDbContext _context;
    private readonly ILogger<AdminService> _logger;

    public AdminService(IUnitOfWork unitOfWork, AppDbContext context, ILogger<AdminService> logger,IUserService userService)
    {
        _unitOfWork = unitOfWork;
        _context = context;
        _logger = logger;
        _userService = userService;
    }


    private async Task<Guid?> GetMyGroupIdAsync(Guid currentAdminId, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        return await _context.Groups
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(g => g.AdminId == currentAdminId && g.IsActive)
            .Select(g => (Guid?)g.Id)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>> GetMyGroupMembersAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} attempted to list members but administers no active group", currentAdminId);
            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var query = _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.GroupId == myGroupId && u.Role == UserRole.User);

        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pagination.SearchTerm))
        {
            var term = pagination.SearchTerm.Trim();
            query = query.Where(u =>
                u.FullName.Contains(term));
        }

        var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(ct);

     
        var items = await query
            .OrderBy(u => u.FullName)
            .Skip((pagination.PageNumber - 1) * pagination.PageSize)
            .Take(pagination.PageSize)
            .Select(u => new GroupMemberResponseDto
            {
                Id = u.Id,
                FullName = u.FullName,
               
                Email = u.Email!,
                IsActive = u.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,

                Permissions = _context.UserPermissions
                    .Where(p => p.UserId == u.Id)
                    .Select(p => new UserPermissionDto
                    {
                        CanUploadDataFiles=p.CanUploadDataFiles,
                        CanUploadCheckFile = p.CanUploadCheckFile,
                        CanShare = p.CanShare,
                        CanDownload = p.CanDownload
                    })
                    .FirstOrDefault() ?? new UserPermissionDto()
            })
            .ToListAsync(ct);

        return ApiResponse<PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<GroupMemberResponseDto>
        {
            Items = items,
            TotalCount = totalCount,
            PageNumber = pagination.PageNumber,
            PageSize = pagination.PageSize
        });
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>> GetMyGroupMemberByIdAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var member = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == targetUserId)
            .Select(u => new GroupMemberResponseDto
            {
                Id = u.Id,
                FullName = u.FullName,
                Email = u.Email!,
                IsActive = u.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                Permissions = _context.UserPermissions
                    .Where(p => p.UserId == u.Id)
                    .Select(p => new UserPermissionDto
                    {
                      CanUploadDataFiles=p.CanUploadDataFiles,
                        CanUploadCheckFile = p.CanUploadCheckFile,
                        CanShare = p.CanShare,
                        CanDownload = p.CanDownload
                    })
                    .FirstOrDefault() ?? new UserPermissionDto()
            })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);


        var belongsToMyGroup = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(u => u.Id == targetUserId && u.GroupId == myGroupId, ct);

        if (member is null || !belongsToMyGroup)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to access User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

        return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(member);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>> UpdateMyGroupMemberAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, UpdateGroupMemberDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(targetUserId.ToString());

        if (user is null || user.GroupId != myGroupId)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to update User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<GroupMemberResponseDto>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

        user.FullName = dto.FullName;
        user.Email = dto.Email;
      
        await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} updated User {UserId} in Group {GroupId}", currentAdminId, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return await GetMyGroupMemberByIdAsync(currentAdminId, targetUserId, ct);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> RemoveMemberFromMyGroupAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(targetUserId.ToString());

        if (user is null || user.GroupId != myGroupId)
        {
         
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to remove User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

   
        user.GroupId = null;
    
        await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} removed User {UserId} from Group {GroupId}", currentAdminId, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>> UpdateMemberPermissionsAsync(
        Guid currentAdminId, Guid targetUserId, UpdateUserPermissionDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
    {
        var myGroupId = await GetMyGroupIdAsync(currentAdminId, ct);
        if (myGroupId is null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>.Fail(
                "You do not currently administer any active group.");
        }

        var userInGroup = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(u => u.Id == targetUserId && u.GroupId == myGroupId, ct);

        if (!userInGroup)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} tried to change permissions for User {UserId} outside their group", currentAdminId, targetUserId);
            return ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>.Fail("User not found in your group.");
        }

        var permRepo = _unitOfWork.Repository<UserPermission>();
        var permission = await _context.UserPermissions.FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.UserId == targetUserId, ct);

        if (permission is null)
        {
            
            _logger.LogWarning("UserPermission row missing for User {UserId}; creating one now", targetUserId);
            permission = new UserPermission { UserId = targetUserId };
            await permRepo.AddAsync(permission);
        }

  
        permission.CanUploadDataFiles = dto.CanUploadDataFiles;
        permission.CanUploadCheckFile = dto.CanUploadCheckFile;
        permission.CanShare = dto.CanShare;
        permission.CanDownload = dto.CanDownload;

       await permRepo.UpdateAsync(permission);
        await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} updated permissions for User {UserId} in Group {GroupId}", currentAdminId, targetUserId, myGroupId);

        return ApiResponse<UserPermissionDto>.SuccessResponse(dto);
    }

    public async Task<AiTranscriptionResult> TranscribeAsync(
        Stream audioStream, string fileName, string contentType, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        using var memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
        await audioStream.CopyToAsync(memoryStream, cancellationToken);
        var base64Audio = Convert.ToBase64String(memoryStream.ToArray());

using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.AuthDTOs;
using Bank.Shared.Enums;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using SendGrid.Helpers.Errors.Model;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations
{
    public class AuthService : IAuthService
    {

        private readonly IUserService _userService;
        private readonly IJWTService _jWTService;
        private readonly IConfiguration _conf;
        public AuthService(IUserService userService, IJWTService jWTService, IConfiguration conf)
        {
            _userService = userService;
            _jWTService = jWTService;
            _conf = conf;
        }
        public async Task<ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>> RegisterAsync(RegisterDTO registerDTO)
        {
            if (registerDTO is null)
                return ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>.Fail("please fill the form");
            var existingUser = await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(registerDTO.Email);
            if (existingUser is not null)
                return ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>.Fail("Email Already Exist");
            ApplicationUser user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName = registerDTO.FullName,
                Email = registerDTO.Email,
                UserName = registerDTO.Email,
                Role = UserRole.Admin

            };
            var Appuser = await _userService.CreateUserAsync(user, registerDTO.Password);
            var res = new RegisterResponseDTO
            {
                UserId = Appuser.Id.ToString(),
                Email = Appuser.Email
            };
            return ApiResponse<RegisterResponseDTO>.SuccessResponse(res, "User registered successfully", 201);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>> LoginAsync(LoginDTO loginDTO)
        {
            if (loginDTO is null)
                return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.Fail("please fill the form");
            var user = await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(loginDTO.Email);
            if (user is null)
                return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.Fail("Email or password is not correct");
            bool isCorrect = await _userService.CheckPasswordAsync(user, loginDTO.Password);
            if (!isCorrect)
                return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.Fail("Email or password is not correct");
            string token = await _jWTService.GenerateJWTToken(user);

            if (!int.TryParse(_conf["Auth:JWT:DurationInMinuts"], out int minuts))
            {
                minuts = 60;
            }
            var result = new LoginResponseDTO
            {
                AccessToken = token,
                ExpireAt = DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(minuts),
                UserLogin = new UserLoginDTO
                {
                    Id = user.Id.ToString(),
                    FullName = user.FullName,
                    Role = user.Role.ToString()
                }

            };
            return ApiResponse<LoginResponseDTO>.SuccessResponse(result, "User logged in successfully", 200);

        }
    }
}

    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<CheckFileSummaryDto>>> GetCheckFilesAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<List<CheckFileSummaryDto>>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var query = _dbContext.CheckFiles.AsNoTracking();
        query = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == currentUserId);

        var files = await query
            .OrderByDescending(f => f.CreatedAt)
            .Select(f => new CheckFileSummaryDto(f.Id, f.FileName, f.TotalPlates, f.IsActive, f.Uploader.FullName, f.CreatedAt))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return ApiResponse<List<CheckFileSummaryDto>>.SuccessResponse(files);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<CheckFileSummaryDto>> UploadAsync(
        Guid uploaderId, CreateCheckFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var timer = System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch.StartNew();
        var validationError = ValidateUploadedFile(request.File);
        if (validationError is not null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected check file upload: {Reason}", validationError);
            return ApiResponse<CheckFileSummaryDto>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(uploaderId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<CheckFileSummaryDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(request.File.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();

        await using (var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream())
        {
            allRows = ReadAllRowsAsStrings(stream, extension).ToList();
        }

        if (allRows.Count < 2)
        {
            return ApiResponse<CheckFileSummaryDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù ÙØ§Ø±Øº Ø£Ùˆ ÙÙŠÙ‡ ØµÙ Ø§Ù„Ø¹Ù†Ø§ÙˆÙŠÙ† Ø¨Ø³.", null, 400);
        }

        await DeactivateExistingActiveFileAsync(userScope.GroupId, uploaderId, cancellationToken);

        var checkFile = new CheckFile
        {
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            UploadedBy = uploaderId,
            FileName = request.File.FileName,
            TotalPlates = 0,
            IsActive = true
        };

        await _unit.Repository<CheckFile>().AddAsync(checkFile);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        var insertedCount = await BulkInsertCheckPlatesAsync(_dbContext, checkFile.Id, dataRows, cancellationToken);

        checkFile.TotalPlates = insertedCount;
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _cache.InvalidateActiveCheckFileCache(userScope.GroupId, uploaderId);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "CheckFile {CheckFileId} uploaded by user {UserId} ({Count} plates across multiple banks)",
            checkFile.Id, uploaderId, insertedCount);
        timer.Stop();
        _logger.LogInformation("CheckFile upload processing time: {ElapsedMilliseconds} ms", timer.ElapsedMilliseconds);

        var dto = new CheckFileSummaryDto(checkFile.Id, checkFile.FileName, insertedCount, true, "Ø£Ù†Øª", checkFile.CreatedAt);
        return ApiResponse<CheckFileSummaryDto>.SuccessResponse(dto, "Ø§ØªØ­Ù…Ù‘Ù„ Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„ØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ Ø¨Ù†Ø¬Ø§Ø­.", 201);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> ToggleActiveAsync(
        Guid checkFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var checkFile = await _dbContext.CheckFiles
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, checkFileId), cancellationToken);

        if (checkFile is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        if (!checkFile.IsActive)
        {
            await DeactivateExistingActiveFileAsync(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        }

        checkFile.IsActive = !checkFile.IsActive;
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _cache.InvalidateActiveCheckFileCache(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId);

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> DeleteAsync(
        Guid checkFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

    private async Task DeactivateExistingActiveFileAsync(Guid? groupId, Guid uploaderId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.CheckFiles.Where(f => f.IsActive);
        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == uploaderId);

        await query.ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(f => f.IsActive, false), cancellationToken);
    }

    private static async Task<int> BulkInsertCheckPlatesAsync(
        AppDbContext dbContext, Guid checkFileId, List<List<string?>> dataRows, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var table = new DataTable();
        table.Columns.Add("check_file_id", typeof(Guid));
        table.Columns.Add("raw_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("normalized_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("bank_name", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("vehicle_type", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("chassis_number", typeof(string));

        var seen = new HashSet<string>();

        // Query DB for already-existing normalized plates for this check file
        var existingPlates = new HashSet<string>(await dbContext.CheckPlates
            .Where(p => p.CheckFileId == checkFileId)
            .Select(p => p.NormalizedPlate)
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken));

        foreach (var row in dataRows)
        {
            if (PlateColumnIndex >= row.Count) continue;
            var rawPlate = row[PlateColumnIndex]?.Trim();
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(rawPlate)) continue;

            var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(rawPlate);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized) || !seen.Add(normalized)) continue;

            // Skip if this normalized plate already exists in DB for this check file
            if (existingPlates.Contains(normalized)) continue;

            var dr = table.NewRow();
            dr["check_file_id"] = checkFileId;
            dr["raw_plate"] = rawPlate;
            dr["normalized_plate"] = normalized;
            dr["bank_name"] = GetCell(row, BankNameColumnIndex) ?? "ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø­Ø¯Ø¯";
            dr["vehicle_type"] = (object?)GetCell(row, VehicleTypeColumnIndex) ?? DBNull.Value;
            dr["chassis_number"] = (object?)GetCell(row, ChassisNumberColumnIndex) ?? DBNull.Value;
            table.Rows.Add(dr);
        }

        if (table.Rows.Count == 0) return 0;

        var connectionString = dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        using var bulkCopy = new SqlBulkCopy(connection)
        {
            DestinationTableName = "check_plates",
            BulkCopyTimeout = 120
        };
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("check_file_id", "check_file_id");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("raw_plate", "raw_plate");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("normalized_plate", "normalized_plate");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("bank_name", "bank_name");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("vehicle_type", "vehicle_type");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("chassis_number", "chassis_number");

        await bulkCopy.WriteToServerAsync(table, cancellationToken);
        return table.Rows.Count;
    }

    private static string? GetCell(List<string?> row, int index) => index < row.Count ? row[index]?.Trim() : null;

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == userId)
            .Select(u => new UserScopeInfo(u.GroupId, u.Role))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression<Func<CheckFile, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid checkFileId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? f => f.Id == checkFileId && f.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : f => f.Id == checkFileId && f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == currentUserId;
    }

    private static string? ValidateUploadedFile(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile? file)
    {
        if (file is null || file.Length == 0) return "Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ±ÙØ¹ Ù…Ù„Ù.";
        if (file.Length > MaxUploadSizeBytes) return $"Ø­Ø¬Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø£ÙƒØ¨Ø± Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­ ({MaxUploadSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024} MB).";

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension))
        {
            return $"ØµÙŠØºØ© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆÙ…Ø©. Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­: {string.Join(", ", AllowedExtensions)}";
        }

        return null;
    }

    /// <summary>Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù…Ø© ÙƒÙ…Ø§Ù† Ù…Ù† ReferralJobService (Ù†ÙØ³ Ù…Ù†Ø·Ù‚ Ø§Ù„Ù‚Ø±Ø§Ø¡Ø©ØŒ Ø£Ø¹Ù…Ø¯Ø© Ù…Ø®ØªÙ„ÙØ©).</summary>
    internal static IEnumerable<List<string?>> ReadAllRowsAsStrings(Stream stream, string extension)
    {
        if (extension == ".csv")
        {
            using var textReader = new StreamReader(stream);
            var config = new CsvConfiguration(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
            {
                HasHeaderRecord = false,
                MissingFieldFound = null,
                BadDataFound = null
            };
            using var csv = new CsvReader(textReader, config);

            while (csv.Read())
            {
                var record = csv.Parser.Record;
                yield return record?.Select(v => (string?)v).ToList() ?? new List<string?>();
            }

            yield break;
        }

        using var reader = ExcelReaderFactory.CreateReader(stream);
        while (reader.Read())
        {
            var row = new List<string?>(reader.FieldCount);
            for (var i = 0; i < reader.FieldCount; i++)
            {
                row.Add(reader.GetValue(i)?.ToString()?.Trim());
            }
            yield return row;
        }
    }

    private record UserScopeInfo(Guid? GroupId, UserRole Role);
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Caching.Memory;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class CheckPlateCacheService : ICheckPlateCacheService
{
    private static readonly TimeSpan CacheDuration = TimeSpan.FromHours(6);
    private readonly IMemoryCache _cache;
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;

    public CheckPlateCacheService(IMemoryCache cache, AppDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _cache = cache;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
    }

    public async Task<bool> IsPlateInActiveCheckFileAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid userId, string normalizedPlate, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var key = BuildCacheKey(groupId, userId);

        var plateSet = await _cache.GetOrCreateAsync(key, async entry =>
        {
            entry.AbsoluteExpirationRelativeToNow = CacheDuration;

            var query = _dbContext.CheckPlates
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(cp => cp.CheckFile.IsActive);

            query = groupId.HasValue
                ? query.Where(cp => cp.CheckFile.GroupId == groupId.Value)
                : query.Where(cp => cp.CheckFile.GroupId == null && cp.CheckFile.UploadedBy == userId);

            var plates = await query.Select(cp => cp.NormalizedPlate).ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
            return new HashSet<string>(plates, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        });

        return plateSet?.Contains(normalizedPlate) ?? false;
    }

    public void InvalidateActiveCheckFileCache(Guid? groupId, Guid userId)
    {
        _cache.Remove(BuildCacheKey(groupId, userId));
    }

    private static string BuildCacheKey(Guid? groupId, Guid userId) =>
        groupId.HasValue ? $"active-check-plates:group:{groupId.Value}" : $"active-check-plates:user:{userId}";
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
using Bank.Repo.Interfaces;
using Bank.Services.HangFireJobs;
using Bank.Services.Helpers;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs;
using Bank.Shared.DTOs.DataFileDTOs;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class DataFileService : IDataFileService
{
    private const long MaxUploadSizeBytes = 200L * 1024 * 1024;
    private static readonly string[] AllowedExtensions = { ".xlsx", ".xlsm", ".xltx", ".xltm", ".xlsb", ".xls", ".csv" };
    private readonly ILogger<DataFileService> _logger;
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unit;
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IFileStorageService _fileStorageService;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient;

    public DataFileService(
        ILogger<DataFileService> logger,
        IUnitOfWork unit,
        AppDbContext context,
        IFileStorageService fileStorageService,
        IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _unit = unit;
        _dbContext = context;
        _fileStorageService = fileStorageService;
        _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;

    public async Task<ApiResponse<DataFileImportStatusDto>> GetImportStatusAsync(
    Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<DataFileImportStatusDto>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

      
        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, dataFileId))
            .Select(f => new DataFileImportStatusDto(f.Id, f.ImportStatus.ToString(), f.RowCount, f.ImportError))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        return dataFile is null
            ? ApiResponse<DataFileImportStatusDto>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.", null, 404)
            : ApiResponse<DataFileImportStatusDto>.SuccessResponse(dataFile);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>> GetDataFilesAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        var query = _dbContext.DataFiles.AsNoTracking();

        query = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId);

        // Query واحدة بس — الـ aggregation (totalRows/currentUserRows) بتحصل
        // على نفس الـ list اللي رجعت من الداتابيز، من غير round trips إضافية.
        var files = await query
            .OrderBy(f => f.SortOrder)
            .Select(f => new DataFileRow(
                f.Id, f.FileName, f.RowCount, f.IsActiveForFiltering, f.SortOrder,
                f.PasswordHash != null, f.Owner.FullName, f.OwnerId, f.ImportStatus.ToString(), f.CreatedAt))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var items = files.Select(f => new DataFileSummaryDto(
                f.Id, f.FileName, f.RowCount, f.IsActiveForFiltering, f.SortOrder,
                f.RequiresPassword, f.OwnerName, f.ImportStatus, f.CreatedAt))
            .ToList();

        var totalRows = files.Sum(f => (long)f.RowCount);
        var currentUserRows = files.Where(f => f.OwnerId == currentUserId).Sum(f => (long)f.RowCount);

        var header = new DataFilesHeaderDto(items.Count, totalRows, currentUserRows, userScope.DisplayName);
        return ApiResponse<DataFilesListResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new DataFilesListResponseDto(header, items));
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateDataFileAsync(
        Guid uploaderId, CreateDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = FileHelper.ValidateUploadedFile(request.File, MaxUploadSizeBytes, AllowedExtensions);
        if (validationError != null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Rejected data file upload: {Reason}", validationError);
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(uploaderId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        var subFolder = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? $"groups/{userScope.GroupId.Value}"
            : $"users/{uploaderId}";

        await using var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream();
        var storagePath = await _fileStorageService.SaveAsync(stream, request.File.FileName, subFolder: subFolder);

        var nextSortOrder = await GetNextSortOrderAsync(userScope.GroupId, uploaderId, CancellationToken.None);

        var dataFile = new DataFile
        {
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            OwnerId = uploaderId,
            FileName = request.File.FileName,
            RowCount = 0,
            IsActiveForFiltering = false,
            PasswordHash = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Password)
                ? null
                : BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(request.Password),
            StoragePath = storagePath,
            ImportStatus = DataFileImportStatus.Pending,
            SortOrder = nextSortOrder
        };

        await _unit.Repository<DataFile>().AddAsync(dataFile);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} created (groupId={GroupId}) by user {UserId}; queuing import job",
            dataFile.Id, userScope.GroupId, uploaderId);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<DataFileImportJob>(job =>
            job.ImportAsync(dataFile.Id, uploaderId, storagePath, false, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<Guid>.SuccessResponse(dataFile.Id, "الملف اتقبل وبدأ يتعالج في الخلفية.", 201);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> AppendAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, AppendDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = FileHelper.ValidateUploadedFile(request.File, MaxUploadSizeBytes, AllowedExtensions);
        if (validationError is not null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail(validationError);
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .AsNoTracking()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, dataFileId), cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Append attempted on missing DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.");
        }

        var appendFolder = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? $"groups/{userScope.GroupId.Value}/appends/{dataFileId}"
            : $"users/{currentUserId}/appends/{dataFileId}";

        await using var stream = request.File.OpenReadStream();
        var appendStoragePath = await _fileStorageService.SaveAsync(
            stream, request.File.FileName, appendFolder, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation("Append file stored for DataFile {DataFileId} by user {UserId}; queuing import job",
            dataFileId, currentUserId);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<DataFileImportJob>(job =>
            job.ImportAsync(dataFileId, currentUserId, appendStoragePath, true, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "جاري إلحاق البيانات في الخلفية.");
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> ToggleActiveAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        var affected = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .Where(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, dataFileId))
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(f => f.IsActiveForFiltering, f => !f.IsActiveForFiltering),
                cancellationToken);

        if (affected == 0)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("ToggleActive: DataFile {DataFileId} not found", dataFileId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.");
        }

        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} filtering toggled", dataFileId);
        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> ReorderAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, ReorderDataFilesRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (request.Items.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("لا يوجد عناصر لإعادة ترتيبها.");
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        // UPDATE واحد بـ CASE WHEN بدل ما نعمل round trip منفصل لكل عنصر —
        // نفس النتيجة النهائية، لكن query واحدة بس مهما كان عدد الملفات
        // اللي اتسحبت وترتيبها اتغيّر.
        var sql = new StringBuilder("UPDATE data_files SET sort_order = CASE id ");
        var parameters = new List<object>();

        for (var i = 0; i < request.Items.Count; i++)
        {
            sql.Append($"WHEN @id{i} THEN @order{i} ");
            parameters.Add(new SqlParameter($"@id{i}", request.Items[i].Id));
            parameters.Add(new SqlParameter($"@order{i}", request.Items[i].SortOrder));
        }

        sql.Append("ELSE sort_order END WHERE id IN (")
           .Append(string.Join(", ", Enumerable.Range(0, request.Items.Count).Select(i => $"@id{i}")))
           .Append(") AND ");

        if (userScope.GroupId.HasValue)
        {
            sql.Append("group_id = @scopeGroupId");
            parameters.Add(new SqlParameter("@scopeGroupId", userScope.GroupId.Value));
        }
        else
        {
            sql.Append("group_id IS NULL AND owner_id = @scopeUserId");
            parameters.Add(new SqlParameter("@scopeUserId", currentUserId));
        }

        var affected = await _dbContext.Database.ExecuteSqlRawAsync(sql.ToString(), parameters, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Reordered {Requested} data files ({Affected} rows actually matched scope) for user {UserId} in a single round trip",
            request.Items.Count, affected, currentUserId);

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> DeleteAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
    
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("المستخدم غير موجود.", null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
        }

        var query = _dbContext.DataFiles.AsQueryable();

        query = userScope.Role switch
        {
            UserRole.SuperAdmin => query.Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId),
            UserRole.Admin when userScope.GroupId.HasValue => query.Where(f => f.Id == dataFileId && f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value),
            _ => query.Where(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, dataFileId))
        };

        var dataFile = await query.FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Delete attempted on missing DataFile {DataFileId} by user {UserId}", dataFileId, currentUserId);
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("الملف غير موجود.", null, StatusCodes.Status404NotFound);
        }

        dataFile.IsActiveForFiltering = false;
        dataFile.ImportStatus = DataFileImportStatus.Processing;
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} marked for deletion; queuing background cleanup", dataFileId);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<DataFileImportJob>(job =>
            job.DeleteAsync(dataFileId, dataFile.StoragePath, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "جاري حذف الملف والبيانات المرتبطة به في الخلفية.");
    }

    public async Task<(Stream Stream, string ContentType, string FileName)> DownloadAsync(
        Guid dataFileId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope == null) throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("المستخدم غير موجود.");

        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .AsNoTracking()
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, dataFileId), cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null)
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("Download attempted on missing DataFile {DataFileId}", dataFileId);
            throw new KeyNotFoundException("الملف غير موجود.");
        }

        var stream = await _fileStorageService.OpenReadAsync(dataFile.StoragePath, cancellationToken);
        _logger.LogInformation("DataFile {DataFileId} downloaded", dataFileId);

        return (stream, "application/octet-stream", dataFile.FileName);
    }

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == userId)
            .Select(u => new UserScopeInfo(
                u.GroupId,
                u.Group != null ? u.Group.Name : "ملفاتي الشخصية",
                u.Role))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static Expression<Func<DataFile, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid dataFileId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? f => f.Id == dataFileId && f.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : f => f.Id == dataFileId && f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId;
    }

    private async Task<int> GetNextSortOrderAsync(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.DataFiles.AsNoTracking();

        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(f => f.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(f => f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId);

        var maxOrder = await query
            .Select(f => (int?)f.SortOrder)
            .MaxAsync(cancellationToken);

        return (maxOrder ?? 0) + 1;
    }

   
    private record UserScopeInfo(Guid? GroupId, string DisplayName, UserRole Role);

    private record DataFileRow(
        Guid Id, string FileName, int RowCount, bool IsActiveForFiltering, int SortOrder,
        bool RequiresPassword, string OwnerName, Guid OwnerId, string ImportStatus, DateTime CreatedAt);
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.BaseModels;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.JwtBearer;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.IdentityModel.Tokens;
using System.IdentityModel.Tokens.Jwt;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations
{
    public class JWTService : IJWTService
    {
        private readonly IConfiguration  _conf;
        private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
        public JWTService(IConfiguration conf, AppDbContext dbContext)
        {
            _conf = conf;
            _dbContext = dbContext;
        }
        public async Task<string> GenerateJWTToken(ApplicationUser user)
        {
            var key = new SymmetricSecurityKey(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(_conf["Auth:JWT:Key"] ?? "this is my secret key it must be very secure and hidden"));
            var crds = new SigningCredentials(key, SecurityAlgorithms.HmacSha256);

            var roleString = user.Role.ToString();

            var clims = new List<Claim>
    {
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.Name, user.FullName ?? string.Empty),
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier, user.Id.ToString()),
        new Claim(ClaimTypes.Role, roleString),
        new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Jti, Guid.NewGuid().ToString()),
        new Claim(JwtRegisteredClaimNames.Sub, user.Id.ToString())
    };

            //if (roleString is "Admin" or "SuperAdmin")
            //{
            //    clims.Add(new Claim("CanDownload", "true"));
            //    clims.Add(new Claim("CanToggleFiles", "true"));
            //    clims.Add(new Claim("CanAppendToTeamFiles", "true"));
            //    clims.Add(new Claim("CanFilter", "true"));

            //}
            //else
            //{
            if (roleString is "User") { 
                var permissions = await _dbContext.UserPermissions
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(p => p.UserId == user.Id);

                if (permissions != null)
                {
                    if (permissions.CanDownload)
                        clims.Add(new Claim("CanDownload", "true"));

                   if(permissions.CanUploadDataFiles)
                        clims.Add(new Claim("CanUploadDataFiles", "true"));

                    if (permissions.CanUploadCheckFile)
                        clims.Add(new Claim("CanUploadCheckFile", "true"));
                    if(permissions.CanShare)
                        clims.Add(new Claim("CanShare", "true"));
                }
            }

            if (!int.TryParse(_conf["Auth:JWT:DurationInMinuts"], out int minuts))
            {
                minuts = 60;
            }

            var token = new JwtSecurityToken(
                signingCredentials: crds,
                issuer: _conf["Auth:JWT:Issuer"],
                audience: _conf["Auth:JWT:Audience"],
                expires: DateTime.UtcNow.AddMinutes(minuts),
                claims: clims
            );

            return new JwtSecurityTokenHandler().WriteToken(token);
        }
    }
}

using Castle.Core.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations
{
    public class LocalFileStorageService : IFileStorageService
    {
        private readonly string _rootPath;
        private readonly ILogger<LocalFileStorageService> _logger;
       

        public LocalFileStorageService(IConfiguration configuration, ILogger<LocalFileStorageService> logger)
        {
            _rootPath = configuration["FileStorage:RootPath"]
                        ?? Path.Combine(AppContext.BaseDirectory, "App_Data", "data-files");
            _logger = logger;
            Directory.CreateDirectory(_rootPath);
        }

        public async Task<string> SaveAsync(Stream content, string suggestedFileName, string subFolder, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var targetFolder = Path.Combine(_rootPath, subFolder);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(targetFolder);

            var extension = Path.GetExtension(suggestedFileName);
            var storedName = $"{Guid.NewGuid():N}{extension}";
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(targetFolder, storedName);

            await using var fileStream = new FileStream(
                fullPath, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, bufferSize: 81920, useAsync: true);
            await content.CopyToAsync(fileStream, cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation("Stored file {OriginalName} at {Path}", suggestedFileName, fullPath);

            return Path.Combine(subFolder, storedName).Replace('\\', '/');
        }

        public Task<Stream> OpenReadAsync(string storagePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(_rootPath, storagePath);
            if (!File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Requested stored file not found: {Path}", fullPath);
                throw new FileNotFoundException("الملف المطلوب مش موجود في التخزين.", fullPath);
            }

            Stream stream = new FileStream(
                fullPath, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read, FileShare.Read, bufferSize: 81920, useAsync: true);
            return Task.FromResult(stream);
        }

        public Task DeleteAsync(string storagePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var fullPath = Path.Combine(_rootPath, storagePath);
            if (File.Exists(fullPath))
            {
                File.Delete(fullPath);
                _logger.LogInformation("Deleted stored file {Path}", fullPath);
            }
            return Task.CompletedTask;
        }
    }
}

===== D:\repo\Bank System\Bank.Services\Implementations\PlateColumnDetector.cs =====
using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class PlateColumnDetector : IPlateColumnDetector
{
    private static readonly string[] HeaderKeywords =
    {
        "Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©", "Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©", "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©", "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø±ÙƒØ¨Ø©", "plate", "license"
    };

    private static readonly Regex PlatePattern =
        new(@"^[A-Za-z\u0621-\u064A]{2,4}[0-9\u0660-\u0669]{3,5}$", RegexOptions.Compiled);

    private const double MinMatchRatio = 0.8; 

    public int? DetectPlateColumn(IReadOnlyList<string?> headerRow, IEnumerable<IReadOnlyList<string?>> sampleDataRows)
    {
        for (var i = 0; i < headerRow.Count; i++)
        {
            var header = headerRow[i]?.Trim() ?? string.Empty;
            if (header.Length > 0 && HeaderKeywords.Any(k => header.Contains(k, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
            {
                return i;
            }
        }

        var samples = sampleDataRows as IReadOnlyList<IReadOnlyList<string?>> ?? sampleDataRows.ToList();
        if (samples.Count == 0) return null;

        var columnCount = samples.Max(r => r.Count);
        var bestColumn = -1;
        var bestRatio = 0.0;

        for (var col = 0; col < columnCount; col++)
        {
            var nonEmpty = 0;
            var matches = 0;

            foreach (var row in samples)
            {
                if (col >= row.Count) continue;
                var value = row[col]?.Trim();
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value)) continue;

                nonEmpty++;
                if (PlatePattern.IsMatch(value)) matches++;
            }

            if (nonEmpty == 0) continue;

            var ratio = (double)matches / nonEmpty;
            if (ratio > bestRatio)
            {
                bestRatio = ratio;
                bestColumn = col;
            }
        }

        return bestRatio >= MinMatchRatio ? bestColumn : null;
    }
}

using Bank.DAL.Context;
using Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels;
