namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class RecordingSessionService : IRecordingSessionService
{
    private const long MaxAudioSizeBytes = 50L * 1024 * 1024;
    private static readonly string[] AllowedAudioExtensions = { ".aac", ".m4a", ".mp3", ".wav", ".ogg" };

    private readonly ILogger<RecordingSessionService> _logger;
    private readonly IUnitOfWork _unit;
    private readonly AppDbContext _dbContext;
    private readonly IFileStorageService _fileStorage;
    private readonly IBackgroundJobClient _backgroundJobClient;

    public RecordingSessionService(
        ILogger<RecordingSessionService> logger, IUnitOfWork unit, AppDbContext dbContext,
        IFileStorageService fileStorage, IBackgroundJobClient backgroundJobClient)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _unit = unit;
        _dbContext = dbContext;
        _fileStorage = fileStorage;
        _backgroundJobClient = backgroundJobClient;
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<CreateRecordingSessionResponseDto>> CreateAsync(
        Guid userId, CreateRecordingSessionRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<CreateRecordingSessionResponseDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var activeCheckFileId = await _dbContext.CheckFiles
            .Where(f => f.IsActive)
            .Where(f => userScope.GroupId.HasValue
                ? f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value
                : f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == userId)
            .Select(f => (Guid?)f.Id)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var displayName = await GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(userScope.GroupId, userId, request.Street, cancellationToken);

        var session = new RecordingSession
        {
            UserId = userId,
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            CheckFileId = activeCheckFileId,
            District = request.District,
            Street = request.Street,
            ExcelSheetName = request.ExcelSheetName,
            DisplayName = displayName,
            TrackingMode = request.TrackingMode,
            TrackingIntervalSeconds = request.TrackingIntervalSeconds,
            Status = SessionStatus.Recording,
            StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        await _unit.Repository<RecordingSession>().AddAsync(session);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "RecordingSession {SessionId} ({DisplayName}) started by user {UserId}, snapshot CheckFileId={CheckFileId}",
            session.Id, displayName, userId, activeCheckFileId);

        return ApiResponse<CreateRecordingSessionResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(
            new CreateRecordingSessionResponseDto(session.Id, displayName, session.Status), statusCode: 201);
    }

  
    private async Task<string> GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid userId, string baseName, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.RecordingSessions.AsNoTracking();
        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(s => s.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(s => s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == userId);

        var existingNames = new HashSet<string>(
            await query.Where(s => s.DisplayName.StartsWith(baseName)).Select(s => s.DisplayName).ToListAsync(cancellationToken));

        if (!existingNames.Contains(baseName)) return baseName;

        var suffix = 1;
        while (existingNames.Contains($"{baseName} ({suffix})")) suffix++;
        return $"{baseName} ({suffix})";
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> AddGpsPointsAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, AddGpsPointsRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (request.Points.Count == 0) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ù„Ø§ ÙŠÙˆØ¬Ø¯ Ù†Ù‚Ø§Ø· GPS Ù…ÙØ±Ø³Ù„Ø©.", null, 400);

        var sessionExists = await EnsureSessionInScopeAsync(sessionId, currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (!sessionExists) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        var points = request.Points.Select(p => new RecordingGpsPoint
        {
            SessionId = sessionId,
            Location = LocationLinkHelper.ToPoint(p.Latitude, p.Longitude),
            CapturedAt = p.CapturedAt,
            AccuracyMeters = p.AccuracyMeters,
            IsManual = p.IsManual
        });

        await _dbContext.RecordingGpsPoints.AddRangeAsync(points, cancellationToken);
        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> CompleteAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, IFormFile audioFile, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (audioFile is null || audioFile.Length == 0) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ±ÙØ¹ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„ØµÙˆØªÙŠ.", null, 400);
        if (audioFile.Length > MaxAudioSizeBytes) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø­Ø¬Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„ØµÙˆØªÙŠ Ø£ÙƒØ¨Ø± Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­.", null, 400);

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(audioFile.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!AllowedAudioExtensions.Contains(extension))
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail($"ØµÙŠØºØ© ØµÙˆØª ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆÙ…Ø©. Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­: {string.Join(", ", AllowedAudioExtensions)}", null, 400);
        }

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId), cancellationToken);

        if (session is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        await using var stream = audioFile.OpenReadStream();
        var storagePath = await _fileStorage.SaveAsync(stream, $"{sessionId}{extension}", "recordings", cancellationToken);

        session.AudioUrl = storagePath;
        session.Status = SessionStatus.Processing;
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<RecordingProcessingJob>(job => job.ProcessAsync(sessionId, CancellationToken.None));

        _logger.LogInformation("Audio uploaded for RecordingSession {SessionId}; queuing AI processing job", sessionId);
        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "Ø§Ù„ØµÙˆØª Ø§ØªÙ‚Ø¨Ù„ ÙˆØ¨ÙŠØªØ¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙÙŠØ©.", 202);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> RetryAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId), cancellationToken);

        if (session is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);
        if (session.AudioUrl is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ ØµÙˆØª Ù…Ø±ÙÙˆØ¹ Ø£ØµÙ„Ø§Ù‹ Ù„Ø¥Ø¹Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø©.", null, 400);
        if (session.Status != SessionStatus.Failed) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø¥Ø¹Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø­Ø§ÙˆÙ„Ø© Ù…ØªØ§Ø­Ø© Ø¨Ø³ Ù„Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„Ø§Øª Ø§Ù„ÙØ§Ø´Ù„Ø©.", null, 400);

        await _dbContext.RecordedPlates.Where(p => p.SessionId == sessionId).ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

        session.Status = SessionStatus.Processing;
        session.ProcessingError = null;
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<RecordingProcessingJob>(job => job.ProcessAsync(sessionId, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true, "Ø¬Ø§Ø±ÙŠ Ø¥Ø¹Ø§Ø¯Ø© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬Ø©.");
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<RecordingSessionSummaryDto>>> GetAllAsync(
        Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<List<RecordingSessionSummaryDto>>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var query = _dbContext.RecordingSessions.AsNoTracking();
        query = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(s => s.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value)
            : query.Where(s => s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == currentUserId);

        var sessions = await query
            .OrderByDescending(s => s.StartedAt)
            .Select(s => new
            {
                s.Id,
                s.DisplayName,
                s.Status,
                s.TotalGpsPoints,
                s.TotalPlates,
                s.StartedAt,
                s.EndedAt,
                MatchedCount = s.RecordedPlates.Count(p => p.IsMatched)
            })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var items = sessions.Select(s => new RecordingSessionSummaryDto(
            s.Id, s.DisplayName, s.Status,
            s.EndedAt.HasValue ? (int)(s.EndedAt.Value - s.StartedAt).TotalSeconds : null,
            s.TotalGpsPoints, s.TotalPlates, s.MatchedCount, s.TotalPlates - s.MatchedCount, s.StartedAt))
            .ToList();

        return ApiResponse<List<RecordingSessionSummaryDto>>.SuccessResponse(items);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<RecordingSessionDetailDto>> GetByIdAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<RecordingSessionDetailDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId))
            .Select(s => new RecordingSessionDetailDto(
                s.Id, s.DisplayName, s.District, s.Street, s.ExcelSheetName, s.TrackingMode, s.TrackingIntervalSeconds,
                s.Status, s.ProcessingError, s.TotalGpsPoints, s.TotalPlates, s.StartedAt, s.EndedAt))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        return session is null
            ? ApiResponse<RecordingSessionDetailDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404)
            : ApiResponse<RecordingSessionDetailDto>.SuccessResponse(session);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<RecordedPlateRowDto>>> GetPlatesAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, int page, int pageSize, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var inScope = await EnsureSessionInScopeAsync(sessionId, currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (!inScope) return ApiResponse<PagedResult<RecordedPlateRowDto>>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        var query = _dbContext.RecordedPlates.AsNoTracking().Where(p => p.SessionId == sessionId);
        var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(cancellationToken);

        var rows = await query
            .OrderBy(p => p.SequenceNumber)
            .Skip((page - 1) * pageSize)
            .Take(pageSize)
            .Select(p => new { p.Id, p.NormalizedPlate, p.Notes, p.VehicleType, p.Street, p.District, p.RecordedAt, p.Location, p.IsMatched })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        var items = rows.Select(p => new RecordedPlateRowDto(
            p.Id, p.NormalizedPlate, p.Notes, p.VehicleType, p.Street, p.District, p.RecordedAt,
            LocationLinkHelper.ToGoogleMapsLink(p.Location), p.IsMatched))
            .ToList();
        var result = new PagedResult<RecordedPlateRowDto>
        {
            Items = items,
            PageNumber = page,
            PageSize = pageSize,
            TotalCount = totalCount
        };
        return ApiResponse<PagedResult<RecordedPlateRowDto>>.SuccessResponse(result);
    }

    public async Task<(Stream Stream, string ContentType, string FileName)> GetAudioAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId))
            .Select(s => new { s.AudioUrl, s.DisplayName })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (session?.AudioUrl is null) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ ØµÙˆØª Ù…ØªØ§Ø­ Ù„Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ Ø¯Ù‡.");

        var stream = await _fileStorage.OpenReadAsync(session.AudioUrl, cancellationToken);
        var extension = Path.GetExtension(session.AudioUrl);
        return (stream, "audio/aac", $"{session.DisplayName}{extension}");
    }

    public async Task<(byte[] FileBytes, string FileName)> ExportAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId))
            .Select(s => s.DisplayName)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (session is null) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var rows = await _dbContext.RecordedPlates
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(p => p.SessionId == sessionId)
            .OrderBy(p => p.SequenceNumber)
            .Select(p => new { p.NormalizedPlate, p.IsMatched, p.Notes, p.VehicleType, p.Street, p.District, p.RecordedAt, p.Location })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        using var workbook = new XLWorkbook();
        var sheet = workbook.Worksheets.Add("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„");
        sheet.RightToLeft = true;

        sheet.Cell(1, 1).Value = "Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø©";
        sheet.Cell(1, 2).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø§Ù„Ø©";
        sheet.Cell(1, 3).Value = "Ù…Ù„Ø§Ø­Ø¸Ø§Øª";
        sheet.Cell(1, 4).Value = "Ù†ÙˆØ¹ Ø§Ù„Ø³ÙŠØ§Ø±Ø©";
        sheet.Cell(1, 5).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ø´Ø§Ø±Ø¹";
        sheet.Cell(1, 6).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ø­ÙŠ";
        sheet.Cell(1, 7).Value = "Ø§Ù„ØªØ§Ø±ÙŠØ®";
        sheet.Cell(1, 8).Value = "Ø§Ù„Ù…ÙˆÙ‚Ø¹";

        var r = 2;
        foreach (var row in rows)
        {
            sheet.Cell(r, 1).Value = row.NormalizedPlate;
            sheet.Cell(r, 2).Value = row.IsMatched ? "Ù…Ø·Ø§Ø¨Ù‚Ø©" : "ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø·Ø§Ø¨Ù‚Ø©";
            sheet.Cell(r, 3).Value = row.Notes;
            sheet.Cell(r, 4).Value = row.VehicleType;
            sheet.Cell(r, 5).Value = row.Street;
            sheet.Cell(r, 6).Value = row.District;
            sheet.Cell(r, 7).Value = row.RecordedAt;
            sheet.Cell(r, 8).Value = LocationLinkHelper.ToGoogleMapsLink(row.Location);
            r++;
        }
        sheet.Columns().AdjustToContents();

        using var stream = new MemoryStream();
        workbook.SaveAs(stream);
        return (stream.ToArray(), $"{session}.xlsx");
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<AppendToDataFileResultDto>> AppendToDataFileAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, AppendToDataFileRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<AppendToDataFileResultDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var dataFile = await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .Where(f => f.Id == request.DataFileId)
            .Where(f => userScope.GroupId.HasValue ? f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value : f.GroupId == null && f.OwnerId == currentUserId)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (dataFile is null) return ApiResponse<AppendToDataFileResultDto>.Fail("Ù…Ù„Ù Ø§Ù„Ø¯Ø§ØªØ§ Ø§Ù„ØªØ§Ø±ÙŠØ®ÙŠØ© ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        var query = _dbContext.RecordedPlates.AsNoTracking().Where(p => p.SessionId == sessionId);
        query = request.AppendMode switch
        {
            RecordingAppendMode.MatchedOnly => query.Where(p => p.IsMatched),
            RecordingAppendMode.UnmatchedOnly => query.Where(p => !p.IsMatched),
            _ => query
        };

        var plates = await query
            .Select(p => new { p.RawPlate, p.NormalizedPlate, p.VehicleType, p.District, p.Street, p.Location, p.RecordedAt })
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (plates.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<AppendToDataFileResultDto>.SuccessResponse(new AppendToDataFileResultDto(0), "Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø§Øª Ù…Ø·Ø§Ø¨Ù‚Ø© Ù„Ù„Ø´Ø±Ø· Ø¯Ù‡.");
        }

  
        var historicalPlates = plates.Select(p => new HistoricalPlate
        {
            DataFileId = dataFile.Id,
            UserId = currentUserId,
            RawPlate = p.RawPlate,
            NormalizedPlate = p.NormalizedPlate,
            VehicleType = p.VehicleType,
            District = p.District,
            Street = p.Street,
            Location = LocationLinkHelper.ToGoogleMapsLink(p.Location),
            RecordedAt = p.RecordedAt.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
        });

        await _dbContext.HistoricalPlates.AddRangeAsync(historicalPlates, cancellationToken);

        await _dbContext.DataFiles
            .Where(f => f.Id == dataFile.Id)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(f => f.RowCount, f => f.RowCount + plates.Count), cancellationToken);

        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Appended {Count} plates from RecordingSession {SessionId} into DataFile {DataFileId} (mode={Mode})",
            plates.Count, sessionId, dataFile.Id, request.AppendMode);

        return ApiResponse<AppendToDataFileResultDto>.SuccessResponse(new AppendToDataFileResultDto(plates.Count));
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> DeleteAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var session = await _dbContext.RecordingSessions
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId), cancellationToken);

        if (session is null) return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.", null, 404);

        if (session.Status == SessionStatus.Processing)
        {
            return ApiResponse<bool>.Fail("Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ Ù„Ø³Ù‡ Ø¨ÙŠØªØ¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬ â€” Ø§Ø³ØªÙ†Ù‰ Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ù…Ø§ ÙŠØ®Ù„Øµ Ù‚Ø¨Ù„ Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø°Ù.", null, 409);
        }

        var audioUrl = session.AudioUrl;

        await _unit.Repository<RecordingSession>().RemoveAsync(session);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        if (audioUrl is not null)
        {
            await _fileStorage.DeleteAsync(audioUrl, cancellationToken);
        }

        _logger.LogInformation("RecordingSession {SessionId} deleted by user {UserId}", sessionId, currentUserId);
        return ApiResponse<bool>.SuccessResponse(true);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<int>> DeleteAllAsync(Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<int>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var query = _dbContext.RecordingSessions.AsQueryable();
        query = userScope.GroupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(s => s.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value)
            : query.Where(s => s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == currentUserId);

        var sessions = await query.Select(s => new { s.Id, s.AudioUrl }).ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (sessions.Count == 0) return ApiResponse<int>.SuccessResponse(0, "Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„Ø§Øª Ø£ØµÙ„Ø§Ù‹.");

        var ids = sessions.Select(s => s.Id).ToList();

         await _dbContext.RecordingSessions.Where(s => ids.Contains(s.Id)).ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

        foreach (var audioUrl in sessions.Where(s => s.AudioUrl is not null).Select(s => s.AudioUrl!))
        {
            await _fileStorage.DeleteAsync(audioUrl, cancellationToken);
        }

        _logger.LogInformation("Deleted all {Count} recording sessions for user {UserId}", sessions.Count, currentUserId);
        return ApiResponse<int>.SuccessResponse(sessions.Count, $"Ø§ØªÙ…Ø³Ø­ {sessions.Count} ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„.");
    }

    private async Task<bool> EnsureSessionInScopeAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(currentUserId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return false;

        return await _dbContext.RecordingSessions.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, currentUserId, sessionId), cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == userId)
            .Select(u => new UserScopeInfo(u.GroupId))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression<Func<RecordingSession, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid currentUserId, Guid sessionId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == currentUserId;
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<ManualCheckResultDto>> CreateManualCheckAsync(
    Guid userId, CreateManualCheckRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.PlateNumber))
        {
            return ApiResponse<ManualCheckResultDto>.Fail("Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ù…Ø·Ù„ÙˆØ¨.", null, 400);
        }

        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<ManualCheckResultDto>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var activeCheckFileId = await _dbContext.CheckFiles
            .Where(f => f.IsActive)
            .Where(f => userScope.GroupId.HasValue
                ? f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value
                : f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == userId)
            .Select(f => (Guid?)f.Id)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var excelSheetName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.ExcelSheetName) ? "ØªØ´ÙŠÙŠÙƒ ÙŠØ¯ÙˆÙŠ" : request.ExcelSheetName.Trim();
        var displayName = await GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(userScope.GroupId, userId, request.Street, cancellationToken);
        var now = DateTime.UtcNow;

     
        var session = new RecordingSession
        {
            UserId = userId,
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            CheckFileId = activeCheckFileId,
            District = request.District,
            Street = request.Street,
            ExcelSheetName = excelSheetName,
            DisplayName = displayName,
            TrackingMode = TrackingMode.Manual,
            TotalGpsPoints = 1,
            TotalPlates = 1,
            Status = SessionStatus.Completed,
            StartedAt = now,
            EndedAt = now
        };

        await _unit.Repository<RecordingSession>().AddAsync(session);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        var point = LocationLinkHelper.ToPoint(request.Latitude, request.Longitude);

        await _dbContext.RecordingGpsPoints.AddAsync(new RecordingGpsPoint
        {
            SessionId = session.Id,
            Location = point,
            CapturedAt = now,
            IsManual = true
        }, cancellationToken);

        var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(request.PlateNumber);

        long? matchedCheckPlateId = null;
        if (activeCheckFileId.HasValue)
        {
            matchedCheckPlateId = await _dbContext.CheckPlates
                .Where(cp => cp.CheckFileId == activeCheckFileId.Value && cp.NormalizedPlate == normalized)
                .Select(cp => (long?)cp.Id)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        var recordedPlate = new RecordedPlate
        {
            SessionId = session.Id,
            UserId = userId,
            SequenceNumber = 1,
            RawPlate = request.PlateNumber.Trim(),
            NormalizedPlate = normalized,
            VehicleType = request.VehicleType,
            District = request.District,
            Street = request.Street,
            Location = point,
            AudioOffsetMs = null,
            IsMatched = matchedCheckPlateId.HasValue,
            MatchedCheckPlateId = matchedCheckPlateId,
            IsManualEntry = true,
            RecordedAt = now
        };

        await _dbContext.RecordedPlates.AddAsync(recordedPlate, cancellationToken);
        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Manual check created: Session {SessionId}, Plate {Plate}, Matched={IsMatched}, by user {UserId}",
            session.Id, normalized, recordedPlate.IsMatched, userId);

        var plateDto = new RecordedPlateRowDto(
            recordedPlate.Id, recordedPlate.NormalizedPlate, recordedPlate.Notes, recordedPlate.VehicleType,
            recordedPlate.Street, recordedPlate.District, recordedPlate.RecordedAt,
            LocationLinkHelper.ToGoogleMapsLink(recordedPlate.Location), recordedPlate.IsMatched);

        return ApiResponse<ManualCheckResultDto>.SuccessResponse(
            new ManualCheckResultDto(session.Id, displayName, plateDto), statusCode: 201);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<InspectReferralFileResponseDto>> InspectUploadAsync(
    IFormFile file, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {

        if (validationError is not null) return ApiResponse<InspectReferralFileResponseDto>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();

        {

            sheets.Select(s => new SheetInfoDto(s.Index, s.Name, s.RowCount)).ToList());

        return ApiResponse<InspectReferralFileResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(dto);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateFromUploadAsync(
        Guid userId, CreateReferralJobUploadRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var validationError = ValidateUploadedFile(request.File);
        if (validationError is not null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail(validationError, null, 400);

        if (!request.AllSheets && (request.SelectedSheetIndexes is null || request.SelectedSheetIndexes.Count == 0))
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ®ØªØ§Ø± Sheet ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ù‚Ù„ØŒ Ø£Ùˆ ØªÙØ¹Ù‘Ù„ \"ÙƒÙ„ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Sheets\".", null, 400);

        {
            sheets = ExcelSheetReader.ReadSelectedSheets(stream, extension, request.AllSheets, request.SelectedSheetIndexes);
        }

        
        var rawPlates = new List<string>();
        foreach (var sheet in sheets)
        {
            if (sheet.Rows.Count < 2) continue;

            var headerRow = sheet.Rows[0];
            var dataRows = sheet.Rows.Skip(1).ToList();
            var sample = dataRows.Take(5).ToList();

            var plateColumn = _columnDetector.DetectPlateColumn(headerRow, sample);
            if (plateColumn is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Could not detect plate column in sheet '{SheetName}' (index {Index}) â€” skipping this sheet", sheet.Name, sheet.Index);
                continue;  
            }

            var platesInSheet = dataRows
                .Where(r => plateColumn.Value < r.Count)
                .Select(r => r[plateColumn.Value])
                .Where(v => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v))
                .Select(v => v!.Trim());

            rawPlates.AddRange(platesInSheet);
        }

        if (rawPlates.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù…Ù‚Ø¯Ø±Ù†Ø§Ø´ Ù†Ø­Ø¯Ø¯ Ø¹Ù…ÙˆØ¯ Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø£ÙŠ Sheet Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ Ø§Ø®ØªØ±ØªÙ‡Ø§.", null, 422);
        }

       
        return await CreateReferralJobInternalAsync(
            userId, request.FilterType, SourceType.FileUpload, request.File.FileName,
            request.Password, rawPlates, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateFromPasteAsync(
        Guid userId, CreateReferralJobPasteRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.PlatesText))
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù…Ø­ØªØ§Ø¬ ØªÙ„ØµÙ‚ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ÙˆØ§Ø­Ø¯Ø© Ø¹Ù„Ù‰ Ø§Ù„Ø£Ù‚Ù„.", null, 400);

            .ToList();

        return await CreateReferralJobInternalAsync(
            userId, request.FilterType, SourceType.DirectPaste, null, null, rawPlates, cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task<ApiResponse<Guid>> CreateReferralJobInternalAsync(
        Guid userId, FilterType filterType, SourceType sourceType, string? sourceFileName,
        string? password, List<string> rawPlates, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == userId)
            .Select(u => new { u.GroupId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (userScope is null) return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

       
        var distinctPlates = new Dictionary<string, string>();
        foreach (var raw in rawPlates)
        {
            var normalized = PlateNormalizer.NormalizeReferralPlate(raw);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized)) continue;
            distinctPlates.TryAdd(normalized, raw);
        }

        if (distinctPlates.Count == 0)
        {
            return ApiResponse<Guid>.Fail("Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ø£ÙŠ Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© ØµØ§Ù„Ø­Ø© ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù/Ø§Ù„Ù†Øµ.", null, 400);
        }

        var referralJob = new ReferralJob
        {
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            UserId = userId,
            FilterType = filterType,
            SourceType = sourceType,
            SourceFileName = sourceFileName,
            PasswordHash = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(password) ? null : BCrypt.Net.BCrypt.HashPassword(password),
            TotalReferralPlates = distinctPlates.Count,
            Status = JobStatus.Processing
        };

        await _unit.Repository<ReferralJob>().AddAsync(referralJob);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        await BulkInsertReferralPlatesAsync(referralJob.Id, distinctPlates, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "ReferralJob {ReferralJobId} created by user {UserId} ({FilterType}, {Count} distinct plates); queuing matching job",
            referralJob.Id, userId, filterType, distinctPlates.Count);

        _backgroundJobClient.Enqueue<ReferralMatchingJob>(job =>
            job.ProcessAsync(referralJob.Id, CancellationToken.None));

        return ApiResponse<Guid>.SuccessResponse(referralJob.Id, "Ø¨Ø¯Ø£Ù†Ø§ Ù†Ø¹Ø§Ù„Ø¬ Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„Ø®Ù„ÙÙŠØ©.", 202);
    }

    private async Task BulkInsertReferralPlatesAsync(
        Guid referralJobId, Dictionary<string, string> distinctPlates, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var table = new DataTable();
        table.Columns.Add("referral_job_id", typeof(Guid));
        table.Columns.Add("raw_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("normalized_plate", typeof(string));
        table.Columns.Add("status", typeof(string));

        foreach (var (normalized, raw) in distinctPlates)
        {
            var dr = table.NewRow();
            dr["referral_job_id"] = referralJobId;
            dr["raw_plate"] = raw;
            dr["normalized_plate"] = normalized;
            dr["status"] = nameof(ReferralPlateStatus.Unmatched);
            table.Rows.Add(dr);
        }

        var connectionString = _dbContext.Database.GetConnectionString()
            ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("Could not resolve the database connection string.");

        await using var connection = new SqlConnection(connectionString);
        await connection.OpenAsync(cancellationToken);

        using var bulkCopy = new SqlBulkCopy(connection)
        {
            DestinationTableName = "referral_plates",
            BulkCopyTimeout = 120
        };
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("referral_job_id", "referral_job_id");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("raw_plate", "raw_plate");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("normalized_plate", "normalized_plate");
        bulkCopy.ColumnMappings.Add("status", "status");

        await bulkCopy.WriteToServerAsync(table, cancellationToken);
    }

                j.TotalReferralPlates, j.SkippedPlatesCount, j.MatchedPlatesCount,
                j.TotalReferralPlates - j.SkippedPlatesCount - j.MatchedPlatesCount,
                j.CreatedAt))
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

        return ApiResponse<PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>>.SuccessResponse(
            new PagedResultDto<ReferralJobSummaryDto>(items, totalCount, page, pageSize));
    }

    private async Task EnsureJobInScopeAsync(Guid referralJobId, Guid currentUserId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == currentUserId)
            .Select(u => new { u.GroupId })
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        if (userScope is null) throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var exists = await _dbContext.ReferralJobs.AsNoTracking().AnyAsync(j => j.Id == referralJobId &&
            (userScope.GroupId.HasValue ? j.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value : j.GroupId == null && j.UserId == currentUserId),
            cancellationToken);

        if (!exists) throw new KeyNotFoundException("Ø¹Ù…Ù„ÙŠØ© Ø§Ù„ÙØ±Ø² ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯Ø©.");
    }
    private static string? ValidateUploadedFile(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.IFormFile? file)
    {
        if (file is null || file.Length == 0) return "Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ØªØ±ÙØ¹ Ù…Ù„Ù.";
        if (file.Length > MaxUploadSizeBytes) return $"Ø­Ø¬Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù Ø£ÙƒØ¨Ø± Ù…Ù† Ø§Ù„Ø­Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­ ({MaxUploadSizeBytes / 1024 / 1024} MB).";

        var extension = Path.GetExtension(file.FileName).ToLowerInvariant();
        if (!AllowedExtensions.Contains(extension))
        {
            return $"ØµÙŠØºØ© Ø§Ù„Ù…Ù„Ù ØºÙŠØ± Ù…Ø¯Ø¹ÙˆÙ…Ø©. Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³Ù…ÙˆØ­: {string.Join(", ", AllowedExtensions)}";
        }

        return null;
    }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>> CreateAdminAsync(CreateAdminDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            if (await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(dto.Email) is not null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateAdmin rejected: email {Email} already taken", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.Fail("Email is already taken.");
            }

            var admin = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName = dto.FullName,
                UserName = dto.Email,
                Email = dto.Email,
                Role = UserRole.Admin,
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            // UserManager handles password hashing, security stamp, normalized
            // username/email — never insert a user manually through the context.
            var adminUser = await _userService.CreateUserAsync(admin, dto.Password);
            if (adminUser is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateAdmin failed for {Email}: User creation unsuccessful", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.Fail("Failed to create admin user.");
            }

            _logger.LogInformation("Admin {AdminId} ({Username}) created", admin.Id, admin.UserName);

            return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new AdminResponseDto
            {
                Id = admin.Id,
                FullName = admin.FullName,
                Email = admin.Email!,
                IsActive = admin.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = admin.CreatedAt
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>>> GetAdminsAsync(PaginationParams pagination, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            
            var query = _context.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(u => u.Role == UserRole.Admin);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pagination.SearchTerm))
            {
                var term = pagination.SearchTerm.Trim();
                query = query.Where(u =>
                    u.FullName.Contains(term) ||
                   
                    u.Email!.Contains(term));
            }

            var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(ct);
            var items = await query
                .OrderByDescending(u => u.CreatedAt)
                .Skip((pagination.PageNumber - 1) * pagination.PageSize)
                .Take(pagination.PageSize)
                .Select(u => new AdminResponseDto
                {
                    Id = u.Id,
                    FullName = u.FullName,
                    Email = u.Email!,
                    IsActive = u.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                    AdministeredGroupId = u.AdministeredGroup != null ? u.AdministeredGroup.Id : (Guid?)null,
                    AdministeredGroupName = u.AdministeredGroup != null ? u.AdministeredGroup.Name : null
                })
                .ToListAsync(ct);

            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<AdminResponseDto>
            {
                Items = items,
                TotalCount = totalCount,
                PageNumber = pagination.PageNumber,
                PageSize = pagination.PageSize
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>> GetAdminByIdAsync(Guid adminId, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            var admin = await _context.Users
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Where(u => u.Id == adminId && u.Role == UserRole.Admin)
                .Select(u => new AdminResponseDto
                {
                    Id = u.Id,
                    FullName = u.FullName,
                    Email = u.Email!,
                    IsActive = u.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                    AdministeredGroupId = u.AdministeredGroup != null ? u.AdministeredGroup.Id : (Guid?)null,
                    AdministeredGroupName = u.AdministeredGroup != null ? u.AdministeredGroup.Name : null
                })
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct);

            if (admin is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Admin {AdminId} not found", adminId);
                return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.Fail("Admin not found.");
            }

            return ApiResponse<AdminResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(admin);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>> CreateGroupAsync(CreateGroupDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            var admin = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == dto.AdminId && u.Role == UserRole.Admin, ct);

            if (admin is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateGroup rejected: AdminId {AdminId} is not a valid Admin", dto.AdminId);
                return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.Fail("The selected user is not a valid Admin.", null, 400);
            }

            var alreadyAdministers = await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking()
                .AnyAsync(g => g.AdminId == dto.AdminId && g.IsActive, ct);

            if (alreadyAdministers)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateGroup rejected: Admin {AdminId} already administers an active group", dto.AdminId);
                return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.Fail("This admin already administers an active group.", null, 409);
            }

            var group = new Bank.DAL.Models.SystemModels.Group
            {
                Name = dto.Name,
                AdminId = dto.AdminId,
                IsActive = true,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
            };

            await _unitOfWork.Repository<Group>().AddAsync(group);
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("Group {GroupId} ({GroupName}) created with Admin {AdminId}", group.Id, group.Name, group.AdminId);

            return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(new GroupResponseDto
            {
                Id = group.Id,
                Name = group.Name,
                IsActive = group.IsActive,
                AdminId = group.AdminId,
                AdminName = admin.FullName,
                MembersCount = 0,
                CreatedAt = group.CreatedAt
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>> AssignAdminToGroupAsync(Guid groupId, AssignAdminToGroupDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            var group = await _unitOfWork.Repository<Group>().GetByIdAsync(groupId);
            if (group is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AssignAdminToGroup failed: Group {GroupId} not found", groupId);
                return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.Fail("Group not found.", null, 404);
            }

            var newAdmin = await _context.Users.AsNoTracking()
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(u => u.Id == dto.AdminId && u.Role == UserRole.Admin, ct);

            if (newAdmin is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AssignAdminToGroup rejected: {AdminId} is not a valid Admin", dto.AdminId);
                return ApiResponse<GroupResponseDto>.Fail("The selected user is not a valid Admin.", null, 400);
            }

            var previousAdminId = group.AdminId;
            group.AdminId = dto.AdminId;
           await _unitOfWork.Repository<Group>().UpdateAsync(group);
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("Group {GroupId} admin changed from {OldAdminId} to {NewAdminId}", groupId, previousAdminId, dto.AdminId);

            return await GetGroupByIdAsync(groupId, ct);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> CreateUserAsync(CreateUserDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            if (await _userService.GetByEmailAsync(dto.Email) is not null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateUser rejected: email {Email} already taken", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Email is already taken.", null, 409);
            }

            if (dto.GroupId.HasValue)
            {
                var groupExists = await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking()
                    .AnyAsync(g => g.Id == dto.GroupId.Value && g.IsActive, ct);

                if (!groupExists)
                {
                    _logger.LogWarning("CreateUser rejected: GroupId {GroupId} not found/inactive", dto.GroupId);
                    return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Group not found or inactive.", null, 400);
                }
            }

            var user = new ApplicationUser
            {
                FullName = dto.FullName,
                Email = dto.Email,
                Role = UserRole.User,
                IsActive = true,
                UserName=dto.Email,
                CreatedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
                GroupId = dto.GroupId
            };

            var newUser = await _userService.CreateUserAsync(user, dto.Password);
            if (newUser is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("CreateUser failed for {Email}: Failed to create user.", dto.Email);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Failed to create user.", null, 400);
            }

            var permission = dto.Permissions is not null ? new UserPermission { UserId = user.Id, 
                CanDownload = dto.Permissions.CanDownload ,

                CanUploadCheckFile = dto.Permissions.CanUploadCheckFile,
                CanUploadDataFiles = dto.Permissions.CanUploadDataFiles
            } : new UserPermission { UserId = user.Id };

            await _unitOfWork.Repository<UserPermission>().AddAsync(permission);
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            string? groupName = dto.GroupId.HasValue
                ? await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking().Where(g => g.Id == dto.GroupId.Value).Select(g => g.Name).FirstOrDefaultAsync(ct)
                : null;

            {
                Id = user.Id,
                FullName = user.FullName,
                Email = user.Email!,
                IsActive = user.IsActive,
                CreatedAt = user.CreatedAt,
                GroupId = user.GroupId,
                GroupName = groupName
            });

        public async Task<ApiResponse<PagedResult<UserResponseDto>>> GetUsersAsync(PaginationParams pagination, Guid? groupId, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
            var query = _context.Users.AsNoTracking().Where(u => u.Role == UserRole.User);

            if (groupId.HasValue)
            {
                query = query.Where(u => u.GroupId == groupId.Value);
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(pagination.SearchTerm))
            {
                var term = pagination.SearchTerm.Trim();
                query = query.Where(u =>
                    u.FullName.Contains(term) ||
                    u.Email!.Contains(term));
            }

            var totalCount = await query.CountAsync(ct);

            var items = await query
                .OrderByDescending(u => u.CreatedAt)
                .Skip((pagination.PageNumber - 1) * pagination.PageSize)
                .Take(pagination.PageSize)
                .Select(u => new UserResponseDto
                {
                    Id = u.Id,
                    FullName = u.FullName,
                    Email = u.Email!,
                    IsActive = u.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                    GroupId = u.GroupId,
                    GroupName = u.Group != null ? u.Group.Name : null
                })
                .ToListAsync(ct);

            return ApiResponse<PagedResult<UserResponseDto>>.SuccessResponse(new PagedResult<UserResponseDto>
            {
                Items = items,
                TotalCount = totalCount,
                PageNumber = pagination.PageNumber,
                PageSize = pagination.PageSize
            });
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> GetUserByIdAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {

                    Id = u.Id,
                    FullName = u.FullName,
                    Email = u.Email!,
                    IsActive = u.IsActive,
                    CreatedAt = u.CreatedAt,
                    GroupId = u.GroupId,
                    GroupName = u.Group != null ? u.Group.Name : null

            if (user is null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("User {UserId} not found", userId);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("User not found.", null, 404);
            }

            return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.SuccessResponse(user);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<bool>> SetUserToggleActiveStatusAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> AssignUserToGroupAsync(Guid userId, AssignUserToGroupDto dto, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
           
            var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user is null || user.Role != UserRole.User)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AssignUserToGroup failed: User {UserId} not found", userId);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("User not found.", null, 404);
            }

            var groupExists = await _context.Groups.AsNoTracking()
                .AnyAsync(g => g.Id == dto.GroupId && g.IsActive, ct);

            if (!groupExists)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("AssignUserToGroup rejected: GroupId {GroupId} not found/inactive", dto.GroupId);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("Group not found or inactive.", null, 400);
            }

            var previousGroupId = user.GroupId;
            user.GroupId = dto.GroupId;
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} moved from Group {OldGroupId} to Group {NewGroupId}", userId, previousGroupId, dto.GroupId);

            return await GetUserByIdAsync(userId, ct);
        }

        public async Task<ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>> RemoveUserFromGroupAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken ct = default)
        {
          
            var user = await _userService.GetByIdAsync(userId.ToString());
            if (user is null || user.Role != UserRole.User)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("RemoveUserFromGroup failed: User {UserId} not found", userId);
                return ApiResponse<UserResponseDto>.Fail("User not found.", null, 404);
            }

            var previousGroupId = user.GroupId;
            user.GroupId = null;
            await _unitOfWork.CompleteAsync();

            _logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} removed from Group {GroupId}", userId, previousGroupId);

            return await GetUserByIdAsync(userId, ct);
        }
    }

using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Bank.Services.Interfaces;

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

// â­ Singleton â€” Ù„Ø§Ø²Ù… ÙŠØªØ³Ø¬Ù„ AddSingleton Ù…Ø´ ScopedØŒ Ø¹Ø´Ø§Ù† ÙŠÙØ¶Ù„ Ù†ÙØ³ Ø§Ù„Ù€
// dictionary Ø·ÙˆÙ„ Ø¹Ù…Ø± Ø§Ù„ØªØ·Ø¨ÙŠÙ‚ Ù…Ù‡Ù…Ø§ ÙƒØ§Ù† Ø¹Ø¯Ø¯ Ø§Ù„Ù€ Hub instances Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙŠ SignalR Ø¨ÙŠØ¹Ù…Ù„Ù‡Ø§.
public class LiveCheckConnectionManager : ILiveCheckConnectionManager
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, LiveCheckConnectionState> _connections = new();

    public void Add(string connectionId, LiveCheckConnectionState state) => _connections[connectionId] = state;

    public LiveCheckConnectionState? Get(string connectionId) =>
        _connections.TryGetValue(connectionId, out var state) ? state : null;

    public void Remove(string connectionId) => _connections.TryRemove(connectionId, out _);
}

namespace Bank.Services.Implementations;

public class LiveCheckSessionService : ILiveCheckSessionService

    public LiveCheckSessionService(ILogger<LiveCheckSessionService> logger, IUnitOfWork unit, AppDbContext dbContext)
    {
        _logger = logger;

    public async Task<(CheckSession Session, Guid? CheckFileId)> CreateSessionAsync(
        Guid userId, string district, string street, string? excelSheetName, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) throw new UnauthorizedAccessException("Ø§Ù„Ù…Ø³ØªØ®Ø¯Ù… ØºÙŠØ± Ù…ÙˆØ¬ÙˆØ¯.");

        var activeCheckFileId = await _dbContext.CheckFiles
            .Where(f => f.IsActive)
            .Where(f => userScope.GroupId.HasValue
                ? f.GroupId == userScope.GroupId.Value
                : f.GroupId == null && f.UploadedBy == userId)
            .Select(f => (Guid?)f.Id)
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);

        var displayName = await GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(userScope.GroupId, userId, street, cancellationToken);

        var session = new CheckSession
        {
            UserId = userId,
            GroupId = userScope.GroupId,
            CheckFileId = activeCheckFileId,
            District = district,
            Street = street,
            ExcelSheetName = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(excelSheetName) ? displayName : excelSheetName!.Trim(),
            DisplayName = displayName,
            Status = SessionStatus.Recording,
            StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        await _unit.Repository<CheckSession>().AddAsync(session);
        await _unit.CompleteAsync();

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "CheckSession {SessionId} ({DisplayName}) started by user {UserId}, snapshot CheckFileId={CheckFileId}",
            session.Id, displayName, userId, activeCheckFileId);

        return (session, activeCheckFileId);
    }

    public async Task<LiveCheckPlateResultDto> ProcessDetectionAsync(
        Guid sessionId, Guid userId, Guid? groupId, Guid? checkFileId, string district, string street,
        double? latitude, double? longitude, AiPlateDetectedEvent detection, CheckType checkType,
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var normalized = PlateNormalizer.Normalize(detection.PlateNumber);

        long? matchedCheckPlateId = null;
        if (checkFileId.HasValue)
        {
            matchedCheckPlateId = await _dbContext.CheckPlates
                .Where(cp => cp.CheckFileId == checkFileId.Value && cp.NormalizedPlate == normalized)
                .Select(cp => (long?)cp.Id)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
        }

        var locationLink = (latitude.HasValue && longitude.HasValue)
            ? LocationLinkHelper.ToGoogleMapsLink(latitude.Value, longitude.Value)
            : null;

        var log = new LiveCheckLog
        {
            CheckSessionId = sessionId,
            UserId = userId,
            GroupId = groupId,
            RawPlate = detection.PlateNumber,
            NormalizedPlate = normalized,
            CheckType = checkType,
            VehicleType = detection.VehicleType,
            District = district,
            Street = street,
            Location = locationLink,
            IsMatched = matchedCheckPlateId.HasValue,
            MatchedCheckPlateId = matchedCheckPlateId,
            CheckedAt = DateTime.UtcNow
        };

        await _dbContext.LiveCheckLogs.AddAsync(log, cancellationToken);

        await _dbContext.CheckSessions
            .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters.SetProperty(s => s.TotalPlates, s => s.TotalPlates + 1), cancellationToken);

        await _dbContext.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

        return new LiveCheckPlateResultDto(log.Id, log.NormalizedPlate, log.VehicleType, log.IsMatched, log.Location, log.CheckedAt);
    }

    public async Task CompleteSessionAsync(Guid sessionId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await _dbContext.CheckSessions
            .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Completed)
                .SetProperty(s => s.EndedAt, DateTime.UtcNow),
                cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task MarkSessionFailedAsync(Guid sessionId, string error, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await _dbContext.CheckSessions
            .Where(s => s.Id == sessionId)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Failed)
                .SetProperty(s => s.ProcessingError, error)
                .SetProperty(s => s.EndedAt, DateTime.UtcNow),
                cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<ManualLiveCheckResultDto>> CreateManualCheckAsync(
        Guid userId, CreateManualLiveCheckRequestDto request, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.PlateNumber))
        {
            return ApiResponse<ManualLiveCheckResultDto>.Fail("Ø±Ù‚Ù… Ø§Ù„Ù„ÙˆØ­Ø© Ù…Ø·Ù„ÙˆØ¨.", null, 400);
        }

        var (session, checkFileId) = await CreateSessionAsync(userId, request.District, request.Street, request.ExcelSheetName, cancellationToken);

        // â­ Ø¨Ù†Ù‚ÙÙ„Ù‡Ø§ ÙÙˆØ±Ù‹Ø§ ÙƒÙ€ session ÙƒØ§Ù…Ù„Ø© â€” Ø²ÙŠ Ø§Ù„ØªØ´ÙŠÙƒ Ø§Ù„ÙŠØ¯ÙˆÙŠ ÙÙŠ Ø§Ù„ØªØ³Ø¬ÙŠÙ„ Ø¨Ø§Ù„Ø¸Ø¨Ø·ØŒ standalone Ù…Ù† ØºÙŠØ± streaming
        await _dbContext.CheckSessions
            .Where(s => s.Id == session.Id)
            .ExecuteUpdateAsync(setters => setters
                .SetProperty(s => s.Status, SessionStatus.Completed)
                .SetProperty(s => s.EndedAt, DateTime.UtcNow),
                cancellationToken);

        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);

        var detection = new AiPlateDetectedEvent(request.PlateNumber.Trim(), request.VehicleType, 0);
        var plateResult = await ProcessDetectionAsync(
            session.Id, userId, userScope?.GroupId, checkFileId, request.District, request.Street,
            request.Latitude, request.Longitude, detection, CheckType.Manual, cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Manual check created: CheckSession {SessionId}, Plate {Plate}, Matched={IsMatched}, by user {UserId}",
            session.Id, plateResult.NormalizedPlate, plateResult.IsMatched, userId);

        return ApiResponse<ManualLiveCheckResultDto>.SuccessResponse(
            new ManualLiveCheckResultDto(session.Id, session.DisplayName, plateResult), statusCode: 201);
    }

    public async Task<ApiResponse<List<CheckSessionSummaryDto>>> GetAllAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);

        var count = await query.CountAsync(cancellationToken);
        if (count == 0) return ApiResponse<int>.SuccessResponse(0, "Ù…ÙÙŠØ´ Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø§Øª ØªØ´ÙŠÙŠÙƒ Ø£ØµÙ„Ø§Ù‹.");

        // Cascade Ø¨ÙŠØ´ÙŠÙ„ LiveCheckLogs ØªÙ„Ù‚Ø§Ø¦ÙŠÙ‹Ø§
        await query.ExecuteDeleteAsync(cancellationToken);

        _logger.LogInformation("Deleted all {Count} check sessions for user {UserId}", count, userId);
        return ApiResponse<int>.SuccessResponse(count, $"Ø§ØªÙ…Ø³Ø­ {count} Ø¬Ù„Ø³Ø© ØªØ´ÙŠÙŠÙƒ.");
    }

    private async Task<string> GenerateUniqueDisplayNameAsync(
        Guid? groupId, Guid userId, string baseName, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var query = _dbContext.CheckSessions.AsNoTracking();
        query = groupId.HasValue
            ? query.Where(s => s.GroupId == groupId.Value)
            : query.Where(s => s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == userId);

        var existingNames = new HashSet<string>(
            await query.Where(s => s.DisplayName.StartsWith(baseName)).Select(s => s.DisplayName).ToListAsync(cancellationToken));

        if (!existingNames.Contains(baseName)) return baseName;

        var suffix = 1;
        while (existingNames.Contains($"{baseName} ({suffix})")) suffix++;
        return $"{baseName} ({suffix})";
    }

    private async Task<bool> EnsureSessionInScopeAsync(Guid sessionId, Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        var userScope = await ResolveUserScopeAsync(userId, cancellationToken);
        if (userScope is null) return false;

        return await _dbContext.CheckSessions.AsNoTracking()
            .AnyAsync(ScopeFilter(userScope.GroupId, userId, sessionId), cancellationToken);
    }

    private async Task<UserScopeInfo?> ResolveUserScopeAsync(Guid userId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        return await _dbContext.Users
            .AsNoTracking()
            .Where(u => u.Id == userId)
            .Select(u => new UserScopeInfo(u.GroupId))
            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    private static System.Linq.Expressions.Expression<Func<CheckSession, bool>> ScopeFilter(Guid? groupId, Guid userId, Guid sessionId)
    {
        return groupId.HasValue
            ? s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == groupId.Value
            : s => s.Id == sessionId && s.GroupId == null && s.UserId == userId;
    }

    private record UserScopeInfo(Guid? GroupId);
}

public class WebSocketLiveCheckAiSession : ILiveCheckAiSession
{
    private readonly ClientWebSocket _socket;
    private readonly ILogger<WebSocketLiveCheckAiSession> _logger;

    public WebSocketLiveCheckAiSession(ClientWebSocket socket, ILogger<WebSocketLiveCheckAiSession> logger)
    {
        _socket = socket;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task SendAudioChunkAsync(byte[] chunk, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (_socket.State != WebSocketState.Open) return;
        await _socket.SendAsync(chunk, WebSocketMessageType.Binary, endOfMessage: true, cancellationToken);
    }

    public async IAsyncEnumerable<AiPlateDetectedEvent> ReadDetectionsAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        var buffer = new byte[8192];

        while (_socket.State == WebSocketState.Open && !cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            using var messageStream = new MemoryStream();
            WebSocketReceiveResult result;

            do
            {
                result = await _socket.ReceiveAsync(buffer, cancellationToken);

                if (result.MessageType == WebSocketMessageType.Close)
                {
                    yield break;
                }

                messageStream.Write(buffer, 0, result.Count);
            }
            while (!result.EndOfMessage);

            var json = Encoding.UTF8.GetString(messageStream.ToArray());

            AiRawMessage? message = null;
            var parseFailed = false;
            try
            {
                message = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<AiRawMessage>(json, JsonOptions);
            }
            catch (JsonException ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Could not parse AI message: {Json}", json);
                parseFailed = true;
            }

            if (parseFailed || message is null || message.Type != "plate_detected" || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(message.PlateNumber))
            {
                // â­ Ø¨Ù†ØªØ¬Ø§Ù‡Ù„ Ø£ÙŠ Ø±Ø³Ø§Ù„Ø© Ù…Ø´ "plate_detected" â€” Ù„Ùˆ ØµØ§Ø­Ø¨Ùƒ Ø¶Ø§Ù Ø£Ù†ÙˆØ§Ø¹
                // ØªØ§Ù†ÙŠØ© Ø¨Ø¹Ø¯ÙŠÙ† (session_ready, error...) Ø§Ù„ÙƒÙˆØ¯ Ù‡Ù†Ø§ Ù…Ø´ Ù‡ÙŠÙ†ÙƒØ³Ø±.
                continue;
            }

            yield return new AiPlateDetectedEvent(message.PlateNumber!, message.VehicleType, message.TimestampMs ?? 0);
        }
    }

    public async Task CloseAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        if (_socket.State == WebSocketState.Open)
        {
            await _socket.CloseAsync(WebSocketCloseStatus.NormalClosure, "done", cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
    {
        _socket.Dispose();
        return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
    }

    private static readonly JsonSerializerOptions JsonOptions = new() { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };

    private record AiRawMessage(
        [property: JsonPropertyName("type")] string? Type,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("plate_number")] string? PlateNumber,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("vehicle_type")] string? VehicleType,
        [property: JsonPropertyName("timestamp_ms")] int? TimestampMs);
}

{
    public interface IApiResponse
    {
        bool Success { get; }
        string? Message { get; }
        List<string>? Errors { get; }
        string? TraceId { get; set; }
        int StatusCode { get; set; }
    }

    public class ApiResponse<T> : IApiResponse
    {
        public bool Success { get; init; }
        public string? Message { get; init; }
        public T? Data { get; init; }
        public List<string>? Errors { get; init; }
        public string? TraceId { get; set; }
        public int StatusCode { get; set; } = 200;

        public static ApiResponse<T> SuccessResponse(T data, string? message = null, int statusCode = 200) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = true,
                Data = data,
                Message = message,
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };

        public static ApiResponse<T> Fail(string message, List<string>? errors = null, int statusCode = 400) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = message,
                Errors = errors ?? new List<string> { message },
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };
    }

    public class ApiResponse : ApiResponse<object>
    {
        public static ApiResponse SuccessResponse(string? message = null, int statusCode = 200) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = true,
                Data = null,
                Message = message,
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };

        public static new ApiResponse Fail(string message, List<string>? errors = null, int statusCode = 400) =>
            new()
            {
                Success = false,
                Message = message,
                Errors = errors ?? new List<string> { message },
                StatusCode = statusCode
            };
    }

public class PaginationParams
{
    private const int MaxPageSize = 100;
    private int _pageSize = 20;

    public int PageNumber { get; set; } = 1;

    public int PageSize
    {
        get => _pageSize;
        set => _pageSize = value <= 0 ? 20 : Math.Min(value, MaxPageSize);
    }

    public string? SearchTerm { get; set; }
}
